## SH — App shell, navigation, search, toasts, dialogs, Help & Guide (complete)

**Auditor's summary.** The shell works for its main paths (rail and tab bar navigation, focus moving into the new page with an announcement, openDialog's Escape/focus-restore/scroll lock, search keyboard navigation, cold deep links for most routes), but its shared plumbing has several clear bugs. Global keyboard handling is too eager (Backspace goes Back even when a page used the key; Enter anywhere confirms a non-danger confirm; 'Skip to content' navigates to Home). Phone composition loses information (tab bar labels clipped to 1px, Money/Goals page tabs unreachable, a toast that wraps into a tall pill), and the Governor popover is cut off by the header's stacking context. The route table in router.js is a central hand-kept list, so newer views lose their state in the URL (the Wall's tabs, an opened assignment or reminder, a review run), the Assistant's app_navigate cannot open 13 current pages, and Reports is missing from the rail map. Toasts are a single slot, so Undo from a Daily Review triage is lost as soon as the next action toasts. A brand-new device has no first run: it opens on a busy Home that is already '23 behind' with three unread notices and no prompt to sign in. Help & Guide and docs/GUIDE.md lag the product by two weeks of releases. One earlier P1 (KOS.rerender resetting scroll) no longer reproduces on kos-redraw-1 and was dropped; note for the whole audit that the harness '--theme' flag sets the theme on <html> only, which renders Dawn with Graphite's derived tokens on <body>, so Dawn contrast findings based on harness shots should be re-checked with KOS.governor.setTheme.

**Coverage.** Continued an interrupted earlier run (33 findings in shell.jsonl, kept and de-duplicated); inventory and matrix in findings/shell.inventory.md. Sizes: mac 1470x832, iPad 820x1180 and 1180x820 (coarse, no hover), iPhone 402x874 and 402x760, plus iPhone landscape 874x402. Accounts: empty (reset) and dense seeded. Themes: Graphite, Atelier Dawn (real setTheme and harness flag, compared), First snow (Try on). DOM measurement over the shell controls at the four sizes on 18 routes (touch size, ovals, clipping, overflow), then targeted screenshots. Verified OK: navigation focus/announce, openDialog Escape/focus restore/scroll lock, search arrows/Enter, cold deep links for money/budgets, code/kata, routines/edit/habits, reports/week, creatives/drills, governor/edit, files; review-chip popover placement at mac/iPad; event dialog sizing at iPad landscape/portrait and iPhone; theme-color meta; shop theme shell legibility. Re-checked P1s: toast wrap (holds), tab-bar labels (holds), Governor menu (holds with header art), skip link (holds), Backspace and Enter-confirm (hold by code), iPhone Money tabs (kept from earlier evidence, not re-run), KOS.rerender scroll (NO LONGER REPRODUCES: #stage scrollTop 500->500 on home/calendar/reminders at mac and iPhone; dropped). NOT checked: real offline behaviour (local dev host always uses the network and the harness is signed out), iOS Home Screen status bar with status-bar-style=default (needs a device), the service-worker update prompt (needs two deployed versions), VoiceOver speech itself (only DOM/ARIA inspected).

### SH-01 · P1 · ui — Toast wraps at half the viewport width on phones: tall broken pill over content

- **Independent check:** confirmed; corroboration only, reviewed by Claude 8 Nov
- **Devices:** iPhone (all phones); also iPad/Mac for long toasts (wraps at 410/735px)
- **Detail / repro:** Any toast longer than ~25 characters on iPhone wraps into a 201px-wide, 3-line 'pill' (radius pill on a tall box) sitting over the page content above the tab bar. Reproduced with KOS.ui.toast('You already had 44 badge tiers — they are on the Badge Wall.') at 402x874: rect x=100.5 w=201 h=78.5. Same on every width: the toast can never be wider than half the viewport.
- **Evidence:** shots/shell/toast-iphone.png; eval rect [100.5,735.5,201,78.5]; css/components.css:389-405 (#toast: position fixed; inset-inline-start:50%; translate(-50%) with shrink-to-fit width)
- **Root cause:** A fixed element with left:50% gets an available width of (viewport - 50%) for shrink-to-fit sizing, so text wraps at 50% of the viewport before the max-inline-size ever applies.
- **Proposed fix:** Give the toast an explicit fit-content width independent of its left offset: e.g. inset-inline:0; margin-inline:auto; inline-size:fit-content; max-inline-size:min(var(--toast-max), calc(100% - var(--sp-32))); transform only on Y. Use a rounded-rect radius (r-16) when it wraps, or keep pill only for one line.
- **Flags:** effort S

### SH-02 · P1 · bug — Global Backspace = Back fires even when a page handled the key: Backspace on a Money row opens 'Delete this entry?' AND navigates to the previous page underneath

- **Independent check:** confirmed; corroboration only, reviewed by Claude 8 Nov
- **Devices:** MacBook; iPad with a keyboard
- **Detail / repro:** js/main.js binds Backspace (outside text fields) to KOS.back() on document and never checks e.defaultPrevented. Money's transaction list uses Delete/Backspace on a focused row to delete it (money.js:610) and calls preventDefault, but the document listener still runs: reproduced on #/money/transactions → focus a row → Backspace: the confirm dialog opens while the route has already changed to #/home behind it; cancelling leaves the user on Home, having lost their place. Any future in-page Backspace handler (ink lasso selection, lists, the editor's rows, Mind's list at mindui.js:154 which is inside a textarea so is safe) collides the same way. Backspace-as-Back is also surprising on its own: a stray Backspace with focus on any button (after clicking a card, closing a menu) leaves the page; browsers removed this shortcut for that reason.
- **Evidence:** shots/shell/backspace-money-dialog-over-home.png; eval result {hash:'#/home', dialog:'Delete this entry? QA coffee, −£4.50…'}; js/main.js:20-28; js/modules/money.js:610
- **Root cause:** The shell's history shortcut ignores defaultPrevented and treats any non-text target as free to navigate.
- **Proposed fix:** In main.js return early when e.defaultPrevented, when a dialog is open, or when the target is inside [role=listbox]/[data-keys]; better, drop bare Backspace and keep Alt+←/→ (and ⌘[ / ⌘] on the Mac). Register the listener in the bubble phase after page handlers (it already is) and respect defaultPrevented.
- **Flags:** effort S

### SH-03 · P1 · ui — Governor ⋯ menu is cut off behind the Stage (only half of its first row shows)

- **Independent check:** confirmed; corroboration only, reviewed by Claude 8 Nov
- **Devices:** MacBook, iPad portrait and landscape
- **Detail / repro:** On #/governor, ⋯ in the page header opens a 280x100 (mac) / 280x136 (iPad) popover whose 'HP preview' row is cut in half and whose 'Data: Mine/Empty/Sample' row is completely hidden behind the Stage card below. Same at 1470x832, 1180x820 and 820x1180. Re-checked on kos-redraw-1: reproduces on a cold load of #/governor when the page header carries its painted band (data-state=has-art): hit-test inside the popover at +15/+50/+85px -> [true,false,false]; when the band is missing (after some in-app navigations) the popover draws whole.
- **Evidence:** shots/shell/gov-menu-mac.png, shots/shell/gov-menu-ipad.png, shots/shell/gov-menu-ipadl.png; popover rect mac {x:1165,y:164,w:280,h:100}; css/components.css:35 (.k-pagehead[data-state~=has-art] {position:relative; isolation:isolate}); css/views/governor.css:31 (.k-gv-stage {position:relative; isolation:isolate}) and :65 (.k-gv-tools-pop z-index var(--z-menu)); js/modules/governor-ui.js:420-439 (an inline <details> popover); shots/shell/gov-menu-mac-recheck2.png (re-check)
- **Root cause:** 34e made painted page headers an isolated stacking context; the z-index of the popover now only counts inside the header, and the Stage that follows (also isolated, later in DOM) paints over it. The Governor menu is a one-off <details> rather than the portalled KOS.ui.menu.
- **Proposed fix:** Use the shared KOS.ui.menu (it portals the panel to <body>, js/core/ui.js ~813) instead of a hand-made <details>; or give the painted page header z-index:var(--z-sticky) so its stacking context sits above the following content. Audit any other in-header inline popover after the 34e painted headers.
- **Flags:** effort S

### SH-04 · P1 · ui — iPhone bottom tab bar lost its labels: five bare kanji (灯 学 整 蒐 余) with no Home/Study/Productivity/Collection/More text

- **Independent check:** confirmed; corroboration only, reviewed by Claude 8 Nov
- **Devices:** iPhone (all <700px, incl. iPad Slide Over)
- **Detail / repro:** On iPhone the tab bar shows only the 28px kanji tiles; the English labels are clipped to a 1x1 rect. Design 15a and layout.css's own phone block intend visible labels ('the tree states' compact-rail rules must not clip the tab labels on a phone'). A user who does not read kanji cannot tell 整 from 蒐; the profile/More sheet is the only place the names appear. Screen readers still get the names (sr-only clip), so this is visual only.
- **Evidence:** shots/shell/seed-home-iphone.png, shots/shell/more-iphone.png (bar at y=818-874); eval: label rect {w:1,h:1}, clip rect(0px,0px,0px,0px), #cols has no data-rail and data-tree=none on a phone; css/layout.css:377 (inside @media max-width:1080px: #cols:not([data-rail="full"]) .k-rail-label {position:absolute; clip:rect(0 0 0 0)} — specificity 1,2,0) beats css/layout.css:433 (.k-rail-label {position:static…} — 0,1,0) and :431 only covers data-rail=compact / tree open|closed
- **Root cause:** Regression from 4c29a2f (feat(ipad), 22 Oct): the iPad tier's ID-scoped label-hiding rule also matches at phone width and out-specifies the phone's class-level reset.
- **Proposed fix:** In the ≤700 block add the same reset for the 1080 tier's selector: '#cols:not([data-rail="full"]) .k-rail-label, #cols:not([data-rail="full"]) .k-rail-count { position: static; inline-size:auto; block-size:auto; clip:auto; overflow:visible }' (or scope the 1080 rule with min-width:701px). Add a smoke/visual assertion that a phone tab label has width > 20px.
- **Flags:** effort S

### SH-20 · P1 · bug — Enter on a focused Cancel button CONFIRMS a non-danger confirm dialog (End session, Turn off notifications, Disconnect GitHub, Add a copy/Open existing...)

- **Independent check:** confirmed; corroboration only, reviewed by Claude 8 Nov
- **Devices:** MacBook, iPad with keyboard
- **Detail / repro:** KOS.ui.confirm adds a document keydown listener that calls close(true) on any Enter when !opts.danger, without looking at the event target. Keydown fires before the focused button's click, so Tab to Cancel (or 'Stay', 'Add a copy') and pressing Enter runs the affirmative action. Reproduced: confirm({title:'Replace?'}) -> focus Cancel -> Enter -> onYes ran. Affected non-danger confirms include Focus 'End early?' (ends and pays the session), 'Turn off closed-app notifications?', 'Disconnect the GitHub App?', 'Reset every permission?', 'Free up space', 'Keep in my cloud', 'Back to the defaults?' (FSRS), the sample/empty account switch, Japanese 'Leave the session?', the vault 'Already in the vault' (Enter on 'Add a copy' opens the existing entry instead) and the service-worker 'Update ready'. Keyboard and switch users on the Mac and iPad keyboard are affected.
- **Evidence:** eval: {enterOnCancel:'YES'}; js/core/ui.js:291-292 (function onKey(e){ if (e.key==='Enter' && !opts.danger) close(true); } on document); 51 ui.confirm call sites, the non-danger ones listed by grep in js/modules/focus.js, notifications.js, code.js, cardstats.js, governor-ui.js:450, jarun.js, medview.js, pwa.js:53
- **Root cause:** The affirmative Enter shortcut is bound at document level and ignores which control has focus.
- **Proposed fix:** Only treat Enter as yes when the target is not a button/link (e.g. if (e.key==='Enter' && !opts.danger && !(e.target.closest && e.target.closest('button,a,[role=button]'))) close(true)); or drop the document listener and rely on the focused confirm button's native Enter.
- **Flags:** effort S

### SH-21 · P1 · a11y — 'Skip to content' navigates to Home instead of skipping: href='#main' is read by the hash router as an unknown route

- **Independent check:** confirmed; corroboration only, reviewed by Claude 8 Nov
- **Devices:** MacBook, iPad with keyboard
- **Detail / repro:** The skip link (the first Tab stop on every page) is <a href="#main">. Activating it changes location.hash to '#main'; router.js's hashchange listener parses it, finds no such route and calls home(), so from #/calendar the keyboard user lands on #/home with a new history entry replaced. The one bypass mechanism for keyboard and switch users (WCAG 2.4.1) throws them off the page they were on.
- **Evidence:** eval mac: {before:'#/calendar', after:'#/home', active:'main'}; index.html:61; js/core/router.js:302-306 (hashchange -> onPop -> parse fails -> home())
- **Root cause:** An in-page fragment link in an app that uses the fragment for routing.
- **Proposed fix:** Give the link a click handler that preventDefault()s and calls document.getElementById('main').focus({preventScroll:false}) (or make router.parse ignore hashes that do not start with '#/').
- **Flags:** effort S

### SH-22 · P1 · bug — On iPhone, Money's six views and Goals' This week/This month/All/Done tabs are unreachable: the phone hides the page tabs and its ▾ sheet lists the section's pages instead

At ≤700px components.css hides every [data-phone-tabs] because the phone title bar's ▾ is meant to offer them, but mobile-shell's destinations() only falls back to the page's tabs when the section has NO subnav. Productivity has a subnav (Focus, Reminders, Routines, Calendar, Money, Goals), so the ▾ sheet on Money lists Productivity's pages and the Money tabs are offered nowhere. Measured at 402px: all six Money tabs and all four Goals tabs have width 0, the sheet shows Focus Timer…Goals, and Money's Overview has no link to Transactions/Recurring/Pots/Month. Money's 'Add entry', Transactions list, recurring bills and pots can only be reached by typing a URL. Achievements and the Governor (no subnav) work because the fallback applies there.

- **Root cause:** The phone title bar treats 'section strip' and 'page tabs' as alternatives, but Money and Goals have both; the CSS hides the tabs unconditionally.
- **Proposed fix:** When the page carries [data-phone-tabs] and a subnav exists, show both in the sheet (section pages, then the page's own views under a sub-heading) or keep the page's tabs visible as a scroller under the title bar; add a smoke assertion that every [role=tab] in #main is visible or offered by the sheet at 402px.

### SH-05 · P1 · bug — KOS.rerender() throws the page back to the top on every device: it saves/restores #main.scrollTop but #stage is the scroller

- **RESOLVED:** no longer reproduces on kos-redraw-1 (6 Nov, shell re-check): the stopgap's KOS.rerender keeps #stage's scroll (scrollTop 500 -> 500 on Home, Calendar and Reminders at mac and iPhone). SY-01 is the same defect from the sync side and should be re-checked with SY.
- **Devices:** MacBook, iPad, iPhone
- **Detail / repro:** Every non-navigation redraw (cloud pull, routine auto-tick, achievements touch, Google/Todoist cycle, a goal or money tick, the day review, and 144 KOS.rerender() call sites in 30 files, many after an in-page action) resets the scroll position. Reproduced at 1470x832: #/home scrolled to 600 → KOS.rerender() → 0; #/reminders scrolled to 900 → KOS.rerender() → 0. Browser Back to a long page also lands at the top (reminders 900 → Home → Back → 0). This contradicts the router contract ('a background pull that repaints the page you are on leaves … your scroll position exactly as they were', router.js:25-29, invariant 65) and the standing 'lost position on redraw' rule. Same on iPhone (402x874: #/home 800 → 0, #stage is the scroller there too).
- **Evidence:** eval: {'#/home': ['stage', 600, 0]}; eval reminders {b:[900,0], afterRerender:0, after Back: 0}; scroller probe: #stage overflow-y auto (scrollHeight 2152 / client 772), #main overflow visible; js/core/ui.js:353-356 (var top = main.scrollTop … main.scrollTop = top), js/core/ui.js:1521-1523 (main.innerHTML = ''; main.scrollTop = 0); iPhone eval ['stage',800,0]
- **Root cause:** The scroll container moved from #main to #stage (layout) but ui.js still saves/restores #main.scrollTop, which is always 0.
- **Proposed fix:** Introduce one KOS.ui.scrollRoot() (the #stage on wide layouts, document.scrollingElement on the phone) and use it in rerender (save before, restore after the view drew, and again on the next frame for async content) and in show() (reset to 0 on a real navigation; restore a remembered position per history index on Back/Forward, like the router already keeps args per index). Add a smoke test.
- **Flags:** effort M

### SH-23 · P2 · bug — Navigating to the page you are already on pushes a duplicate history entry, so Back appears to do nothing

- **Devices:** all
- **Detail / repro:** KOS.show() always calls pushEntry() unless it is a _nav redraw; it never compares the new route with lastRendered. Clicking the rail item of the current section, the brand mark on Home, a subject pill for the open subject or a search result for the page in view each add an identical entry. Reproduced: on #/home, rail 'Home' + brand mark raised router depth 7 -> 9 and history.back() stayed on #/home; KOS.show('calendar') twice raised depth 3 -> 5 and history.back() left the user on #/calendar. On the installed app (no browser chrome) this makes Back/Alt+Left look broken.

- **Root cause:** The router wrapper treats every non-redraw show as a new navigation even when the route is unchanged.
- **Proposed fix:** In the KOS.show wrapper: if (!opts._nav && route === lastRendered) replaceEntry(route,arg) instead of pushEntry (still render, so a rail click on the current page refreshes/scrolls to top).
- **Flags:** effort S

### SH-25 · P2 · bug — A dialog survives navigation: Back (or a rail/route change) leaves the confirm open over the new page, still bound to the old page's record

### SH-28 · P2 · a11y — Toast 'Undo' is unreachable without a pointer: the button is tabindex=-1 inside the aria-hidden #toast, and the spoken message never says Undo exists

- **Devices:** MacBook, iPad with keyboard, VoiceOver everywhere
- **Detail / repro:** KOS.ui.toast(msg, bad, {label:'Undo', run}) appends the action button with tabindex '-1' into #toast, which carries aria-hidden='true'; the live region announces only msg. So keyboard users (Mac, iPad keyboard) cannot reach Undo, VoiceOver users never learn it exists, and there is no global ⌘Z outside the ink engine. The action toasts are the only Undo for: Home's plan tick (hub.js:964), Reminders' plan tick (reminders.js:344), the Daily Review's triage Tomorrow/Done/study block (dayreview.js:534,615,621,622). It also disappears after 8 s regardless of focus/hover (WCAG 2.2.1 timing).

- **Root cause:** The toast was made aria-hidden for the live-region split (Phase F) before toasts gained actions.
- **Proposed fix:** Give action toasts their own non-hidden container (role=status) with a focusable button; announce 'msg. Undo available, press ⌘Z' and bind ⌘Z/Ctrl+Z (outside text fields) to the most recent toast action while it is shown; pause the timer while hovered/focused.
- **Flags:** effort S

There is no 'show all results' row, so a result past six cannot be reached.
- **Evidence:** eval: search('binary') title hits at indexes [1,3,4,7,8,12,14,15] of 30; listbox options for 'binary','integration','dijkstra' (printed); js/core/search.js:31 (PER_DOMAIN 6), :42-49 (rank), :60-73 (specDomain: res.slice(0, PER_DOMAIN), no rank); js/modules/hub.js searchSpec (returns specHits in index order)
- **Root cause:** Spec search is a filter, not a ranker, and the cross-domain layer truncates before ranking.
- **Proposed fix:** Score spec hits: exact title > title word-start > title contains > spec text > flashcard, then subject order; rank before slicing; add a final 'See all N results' option that opens a results page (or expands the domain).
- **Flags:** effort S

### SH-30 · P2 · integration — Tapping a notification often lands on a generic page: Daily Review notices open Routines (not the review), routine-window notices ignore the routine, goal notices open the Goals list, and cold-start pushes drop object args

- **Devices:** all; closed-app pushes on iPad/iPhone
- **Detail / repro:** KOS.notify.open(item) does KOS.show(item.view, item.arg). Daily Review items carry {view:'routines', arg:{review:'afternoon'}} and routine windows {arg:{routine:id}}, but KOS.views.routines only reads arg.edit or a tab string, so both open Routines › Today and the review sheet never opens (verified: shots/shell/notify-review-open.png, no review dialog). Goal notices ('Goal reached — Goal 5') are pushed with {view:'goals', arg:null} and open the list (#/goals) instead of #/goals/<id>. The service worker builds its own cold-start hash ('#/'+view+'/'+arg, objects dropped, sw.js:147) instead of the router's routeFor, so a closed-app push for a review, a topic or a report week opens the section landing. One connected OS should take a notice straight to its record.
- **Evidence:** shots/shell/notify-review-open.png; eval: notify kinds review:routines:object, goal:goals:null; goal open -> '#/goals'; js/core/notify.js:196-199; js/core/dayreview.js:713; js/core/routines.js:560; js/modules/routines.js:469-473; js/core/goals.js:807; sw.js:147,154
- **Root cause:** Producers set view/arg shapes the target views never learned to read, and the SW re-implements routing.
- **Proposed fix:** Routines view: if arg.review open KOS.reviewSheet for that slot; if arg.routine open the player/editor. Goals notices: link {view:'goals', arg:{id}}. In the push payload send the router hash (KOS.router.routeFor) and let sw.js open it verbatim; for in-app kos-open keep view+arg.
- **Flags:** effort S

### SH-34 · P2 · integration — Kurenai cannot open 13 current pages: app_navigate's view list stops before Money, Reports, Routines, Files, Achievements, Connections, Storage, Pen and ink, the Assistant and the four study spaces (Code, Japanese, Mind, Creatives)

Every view registered since mid-October is missing: pen, code, japanese, creatives, mind, routines, files, storage, connections, assistant, money, reports, achievements. Asking "open Money" or "take me to my week in review" or "open Japanese lesson 1.2" cannot be done by the tool (the model either refuses or picks a wrong view); a Code/Japanese/Mind/Creatives lesson ref cannot be opened at all. ### SH-35 · P2 · ux — No first run: a new device opens straight onto a busy Home that is already "23 behind" with 3 unread notices, and nothing offers to sign in and bring the account's data over

- **Devices:** all (a new device or a fresh Home Screen install)

There is no welcome, no step that explains what the app is, and no prompt to sign in to cloud sync, which is the only way the user's real data reaches the new device; the sign-in lives on Archive (#/data) with no link from Home, the bell or the empty states (the sync chip is hidden while signed out). A first open therefore shows alarming but fake state and buries the action that matters.

### SH-36 · P2 · ux — One toast slot: each new toast replaces the last, so in the Daily Review (or Home's Today ticks) only the most recent triage can be undone; toasts also vanish after a fixed 2.6 s whatever their length

- **Devices:** all
- **Detail / repro:** KOS.ui.toast writes into the single #toast node (t.textContent = msg) and restarts one timer. The Daily Review's triage buttons (Tomorrow, ✓ Done, Study block, the step actions) each show "<title> · marked done — Undo"; triaging three items in a row leaves only the third's Undo — the first two are committed with no way back, although invariant 144 promises Undo for every change a review makes. Same on Home's Today ticks and Reminders' plan ticks. Any unrelated toast in the 8 s window (a save, a Focus message, the achievements count) also wipes a pending Undo. Plain toasts last 2.6 s regardless of length: "You already had 44 badge tiers — they are on the Wall." or an error with its reason cannot be read in that time (and the toast cannot be paused by hover or focus).
- **Evidence:** js/core/ui.js:71-87 (single node, textContent replace, fixed 2600/8000 ms); Undo toasts at js/modules/dayreview.js:534, :615, :621, :622; js/modules/hub.js:964; js/modules/reminders.js:344
- **Root cause:** The toast is a single-slot primitive and Undo was layered on it without a queue.
- **Proposed fix:** Queue or stack toasts (at most 3, newest on top) and never drop one that carries an action until its time ends; scale duration to text length (e.g. 2.6 s + 60 ms/char, max 10 s) and pause on hover/focus; in the Daily Review keep an inline "Undo" on each triaged row instead of relying on the toast.
- **Flags:** effort M

### SH-37 · P2 · bug — The URL does not record many pages: the Wall's tabs and set pages, an opened assignment or reminder, a review run all collapse to the bare route, so a reload, a bookmark or the Home Screen app relaunch lands on the wrong page

- **Devices:** all (worst in the installed iPad/iPhone app, which iOS relaunches)
- **Detail / repro:** router.js only has ENCODE/DECODE entries for ref, subject, governor, code, japanese, creatives, mind, sims, money, routines, exams, goals, assistant, help, reports and pacing. Views that take an argument without a codec get a URL without it: KOS.show("achievements","titles") writes #/achievements, and the documented deep links #/achievements/sets|recent|showcase|titles|set/<id> (CLAUDE.md ownership map) all open on Sets (cold load of #/achievements/sets even rewrites the hash to #/achievements). KOS.show("assignments",{id}) (from Files' Where it's linked), KOS.show("reminders",{id,section}) (from search), KOS.show("review",{tab,run}) (Cram from the Exams Companion, Due today's queue buttons) and cardstats likewise. In-session Back works (argMemo keeps the arg per entry) but a reload, an iPad Home Screen app that iOS relaunched, or a copied link loses the place. This is also why a push notification opened from a cold start drops its object argument (see the earlier notification finding).
- **Evidence:** eval: #/achievements/recent and #/achievements/titles render with the Sets tab selected; cold load of #/achievements/sets -> hash #/achievements; shots/shell/ach-titles-deeplink-mac.png (hash #/achievements/titles, Sets selected); js/core/router.js:30-148 (ENCODE/DECODE lack achievements, assignments, reminders, review, cardstats), :150-154 routeFor; js/modules/achievements.js:110-115 (reads arg as "tab/id"); js/core/files.js:146; js/core/search.js:115; js/modules/due.js:103-173
- **Root cause:** Route codecs live in a central table in router.js that new views/args were not added to; routeFor silently drops unknown args.
- **Proposed fix:** Add codecs for achievements (tab, set/<id>), assignments (id), reminders (id/section), review (tab, run) and cardstats; better, make each view declare its own route codec next to its KOS.views registration and have a smoke test round-trip every KOS.show call site through routeFor/parse.
- **Flags:** effort M

### SH-13 · P3 · bug — Nothing redraws the open page when the day changes: header clock says Mon 2 Nov, Home still says Sunday 1 November / Good evening

- **Devices:** all; most visible on the installed iPad app
- **Detail / repro:** Left open across midnight (the user's installed iPad app is), the header clock ticks to the new date but the current view is never redrawn, so Home keeps yesterday's date line, greeting, Today list and daily goal until something else triggers a redraw. Observed at 00:00: header 'Mon 2 Nov', hero 'SUNDAY 1 NOVEMBER · Good evening', while the Week's plan card in the same page (drawn later) already read 'w/c 2 Nov'. A manual KOS.rerender() then showed 'Monday 2 November · Working late'.

- **Root cause:** Day-dependent views read new Date() only at draw time and the shell has no day-rollover redraw.
- **Proposed fix:** In tickClock, remember the date string; when it changes (and on visibilitychange after a day boundary) call KOS.rerender() if no dialog/ink/Focus is busy (the rerender already waits on KOS.inkUI.busy).

### SH-33 · P3 · ux — iPad-portrait overlay rail: Escape does not close it, a tap on the page both closes it and activates what was under the finger, and its open state is persisted

- **Devices:** iPad portrait, iPad Split View
- **Detail / repro:** At 701-1080px the opened rail floats over the page. Escape leaves it open (s1 'full' -> after Escape 'full'); focus stays on the toggle rather than entering the rail. The only dismissals are a destination or a pointerdown on #stage, and that pointerdown does not cancel the tap, so tapping the page to dismiss also presses whatever control was under the finger (tap-through). ui.railOpenNarrow is saved, so an overlay left open comes back open over the page on the next launch of the installed app.

- **Root cause:** The narrow rail reuses the persistent open/closed preference of the docked rail instead of being a transient drawer.

The review chip in the header is 40px tall (under the 44px touch minimum).

### SH-40 · P3 · ux — Hold-⌘ shortcut sheet is a fixed list: it shows Ink/PDF/Flashcard keys on every page and omits the shortcuts that exist (Backspace back, Esc, Money row keys, the Daily Review and routine player arrows and S, the story keys, the quiz arrow)

### SH-42 · P3 · arch — <body> also carries data-theme ("legacy hook, harmless"), so every derived token is re-derived on body: anything that sets the theme on <html> alone renders Graphite's derivations under Dawn's roles

- **Devices:** all (Dawn and shop themes)
- **Detail / repro:** governor.js writes the theme to both html and body. tokens.css declares its derived tokens on ":root, [data-theme]", so body re-computes all of them from the inherited roles; themes.css' Dawn restatements win again only because body carries the same id. If the two ever differ (the QA harness sets html only; any future preview/try-on code that sets html, or a stale body value), the body-level Graphite derivations shadow Dawn's restated ones: measured with html=atelier-dawn, body="": Home hero kicker colour oklch(0.8 0.04 235) (unreadable, ~1.2:1 on the light hero) vs oklch(0.42 0.08 235) when both carry atelier-dawn; --home-hero-ink, --home-goal-ink, --home-hero-scrim, --bk-kicker-ink, --mx-wash, --gv-rec-bg and --shadow-ink all differ between html and body. NOTE FOR THE AUDIT: every screenshot taken with the harness' --theme flag has this mixed rendering, so Dawn contrast findings based on those shots should be re-checked with KOS.governor.setTheme.

## HR — Home and Reports (complete)

**Auditor's summary.** Home looks finished, but several of its controls write to the economy without evidence or undo. The hero's Daily goal ticks pay XP and gold on every re-tick. Streak milestone bonuses are paid again every day because the milestone key is derived from a streak that can end 'yesterday'. Reminder and habit ticks have no Undo. Reports still hard-code the three exam subjects: a week led by Code or Japanese is saved with the words 'undefined took the largest share', and study-space time is missing from every subject split. Reports also save empty weeks for a brand-new account (hasContent counts the shipped plan) and freeze 'quiet' weeks saved before history arrives. As a personal OS, Home still answers 'what next' only for CS/Maths/IT, the calendar and reminders: Code, Japanese, Mind, Creatives and Money have no rung. The Continue row hides Mind and Creatives off-screen. Smaller layout issues: touch targets under 44px on text-link buttons, dead space in equal-height cards, the iPhone XP row with almost no slack, and an exam rung that lasts past the exam.

**Coverage.** Continued from an interrupted earlier auditor (15 findings kept, not repeated). This run (slot 2): a DOM measurement scan (overflow, ellipsis clipping, text overlap, touch targets, ovals) of #/home, #/reports, a week page, its study/focus/collection overviews and a month page at mac 1470x832, ipad 820x1180 (coarse pointer) and iphone 402x874, on the seeded and the empty (reset) account. Screenshots looked at: Home iPhone (XP row), Home mac full with a routines fixture, the empty Home and Reports on mac, a Reports index full page at iPhone, the Focus overview at iPhone, Home in Dawn at iPhone, a week report in the Celestial Duality shop theme on mac, and the Kurenai-words failure. Behaviour fixtures: reminder tick and toast; milestone re-pay (today's study removed, then a todo logged); directive tick/untick x4; Code and Japanese Focus sessions against Home's split and the report template; Focus card 90m Start; focusPlan at 09:00/15:00/23:30; background-redraw scroll keep; reset and backfill; Read the report and New state. Matrix in findings/home-reports.inventory.md. NOT checked by this run: Up next rungs other than the exam rung (study block lead, deadline at risk, start-by, assignment estimate, next exam within 6 weeks; budget); term and year pages (no term saved in this seed; the earlier auditor's r-term/r-year shots exist); story player and share/export (covered by the earlier auditor); the iPhone XP overlap in real Safari (no WebKit in the harness, so Chromium geometry only); Goals switch persistence; the iPad landscape scan (ipadl) for Reports. Harness note: the app sets data-theme on <body>, so the harness's --theme flag alone does not re-theme; screenshots used --js to set body.dataset.theme.

### HR-01 · P1 · ux — Mind and Creatives are pushed off-screen in Home's Continue row (fixed subject order, 4 visible, no scroll affordance)

- **Independent check:** confirmed; corroboration only, reviewed by Claude 8 Nov
- **Devices:** mac, ipad landscape (4 across), ipad portrait (2 across)
- **Detail / repro:** Continue renders one desk per started subject in the fixed KOS.subjects order (compsci, maths, it, code, ja, mind, creatives) and then Collection, in a grid with grid-auto-columns = a quarter of the width and overflow-x:auto. With Code and Japanese started (the user's case), Mind is the 6th and Creatives the 7th column: at 1470x832 they sit at x=1766 and x=2072 inside a 1210px-wide row (scrollWidth 2434) and Collection at 2378. macOS hides the thin scrollbar, there are no arrows, no fade, no count, so the desks never appear. A second, smaller cause: KOS.mind.started()/KOS.creatives.started() only become true once a lesson page has recorded a read (state.mind.lessons / state.creatives.lessons|works); a Daily 15, Journal entries or Positions alone never put Mind on Home. Reproduced: fresh seeded account, opened Mind F1.1, Creatives A1.1, Code 1.1, Japanese H1 -> desks order compsci:236, maths:542, it:848, code:1154, ja:1460, mind:1766, creatives:2072, coll:2378.
- **Evidence:** /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-fj-Developer-KurenaiOS---Web/083a292e-9158-4ad4-8d86-0c9b8abd3917/scratchpad/qa/shots/home-reports/seed-home-mac-continue.png; eval of .k-desks: clientWidth 1210, scrollWidth 2434; js/modules/hub.js:1558-1563 (filter + fixed SUBJECTS order); css/views/home.css:183 (grid-auto-columns quarter width, overflow-x:auto); js/core/mind.js:430, js/core/creatives.js:255 (started())
- **Root cause:** Fixed registry order plus a 4-column horizontal scroller with no affordance; started() reads only lesson records.
- **Proposed fix:** Order the study desks by recency (last studied time from the ledger / ui.lastRef timestamps) so what you are doing is always in the first four; make the row wrap into a second line on desktop/iPad (auto-fill minmax columns) or add visible prev/next buttons and an edge fade with a 'N more' count; let started() also count Mind's Journal/positions/cards and Creatives' works.
- **Flags:** effort M

### HR-02 · P1 · data — Weekly/monthly reports saved before the history arrives are frozen as 'A quiet week for study' forever

- **Independent check:** confirmed; corroboration only, reviewed by Claude 8 Nov
- **Devices:** all
- **Detail / repro:** ensureReports() runs at boot and saves every backfilled week since 1 September. The skip rule for an empty rebuilt week is hasContent(), which counts f.plan and f.tasks; the shipped Pacing seed gives every fresh install plan facts, and the LATEST week is saved whatever it holds. So the first boot on an empty device (a new iPad/iPhone before sign-in finishes its first pull, or before a backup is restored with importFull, which does not touch kurenai-os-reports) saves weeks with mins:0 and the month 'October 2026 · a quiet month for study'. Reports are never recomputed (getReport hit -> skip), so after the history arrives Home's Reports card still says 'A quiet week for study · 0m studied' while Study hours on the same screen shows 9.2 h and the ledger has focus sessions on 20, 21, 22, 23 and 25 Oct. Reproduced: reset -> first boot -> seed: week:2026-10-19 and week:2026-10-12 both have facts.study.mins 0, createdAt = the reset boot, while weeks saved during the seed have real minutes.
- **Evidence:** /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-fj-Developer-KurenaiOS---Web/083a292e-9158-4ad4-8d86-0c9b8abd3917/scratchpad/qa/shots/home-reports/seed-home-mac-all-desks.png (Week in review card 0m beside Study hours 9.2); eval KOS.reportStore.cached(): week:2026-10-19 {mins:0,sessions:0} created 1793576817945; ledger has type focus on 2026-10-20..25; js/core/reportstore.js:228-231 (hasContent counts plan/tasks), :275-279 (latest week always saved, a saved report is never rebuilt)
- **Root cause:** Save-once reports are created from an incomplete ledger; hasContent treats seeded Pacing rows as activity.
- **Proposed fix:** Do not let plan/tasks alone make a rebuilt week 'content'; hold the first ensureReports until the first cloud pull has completed (or until KOS.cloud says signed-out), and after importFull / first cloud link re-run the backfill with a 'replace rebuilt reports whose facts are empty or older than the newest ledger entry in their period' rule (rebuilt reports were never shown as final anyway).
- **Flags:** effort M

### HR-16 · P1 · bug — Streak milestone bonuses are paid again every day: before the first study session the streak 'ends yesterday', which moves each milestone's key date by one day

- **Independent check:** confirmed; corroboration only, reviewed by Claude 8 Nov
- **Review note (8 Nov):** The repeated milestone bonus pays GOLD only (js/core/governor.js:337 gold += ms), no XP.
- **Devices:** all
- **Detail / repro:** governor.js keys each milestone to the date the run reached it, computed as today - (stk - ms). KOS.sessions.streak() counts the run ending TODAY if there is study today, otherwise ending YESTERDAY. So on any morning, the first non-study session (a reminder or habit tick on Home, a routine, a todo) sees stk one lower with today's date, works out a key date one day later than the stored one, and pays 3+7+14+30 (+60/+100) gold again with four '35-day streak' notes. Once the first study session of the day logs, the run ends today again, the key dates move back, and they pay once more. Reproduced on the seeded account: today's 6 study entries removed, then one todo session logged; gold went 12531 -> 12586 (+55 = 1 for the tick + 54 in milestones); milestones moved from streak30:'2026-10-31' to '2026-11-01'; toast '+5 XP · +55 gold · 35-day streak, 35-day streak, 35-day streak, 35-day streak'. Ticking a reminder on Home with study already done today also paid +55 the first time (see study-core's milestone-note finding for the retro-pay and the note text). This is a daily gold leak of up to 2 x 54 (2 x 214 past 100 days), against invariant 1.
- **Evidence:** eval reproduction (slot 2, seeded): gold [12531,12586,12587], m0 vs m1 above; js/core/governor.js:330-339; js/core/sessions.js:166-175 (streak ends today or yesterday); Home tick: js/modules/hub.js:1199 (KOS.reminders.complete then rerender), toast '+5 XP · +55 gold · 36-day streak x4'
- **Root cause:** The milestone key is derived from today's date and a streak length that refers to a run which may end yesterday
- **Proposed fix:** Key a milestone to the run's start date (the first day of the run, which does not move whether it ends today or yesterday), e.g. runStart = lastActiveDay - (stk-1), and store the run start once per milestone. Better: pay a milestone only on the session that makes the streak reach exactly ms days ending today. Note ms, not stk, in the text.
- **Flags:** effort S

### HR-31 · P1 · bug — Reports count a title as active in the period for ANY journal event — a score change, a status tidy-up or a sync echo — so titles with no real progress appear in a week's Collection (and its story, genres, flows)

- **Devices:** all
- **Detail / repro:** js/core/report.js collection() (about :446-456) touches a row for every journal event inside [start, end): (r.journal||[]).forEach(ev => if (ev[0] >= a && ev[0] < b) touch(r)). The media journal (mediadb.js, invariant 99) records progress, volumes, status, score, route, chapter and hours. So changing a score, or moving an old title to Completed or On hold as a tidy-up, counts as having watched or read it this week. The DI-27 echo (volumes null→N on every sync) made Death Note and Aku no Kyouten appear every week too. The touched set feeds the week's titles, byModule counts, genre and studio/author tallies, the genre-flow, and the stories. The user reported it 8 Nov: 'titles who haven't had actual progress made in the time frame should not appear, e.g. changing a score should not count as something having been done this week.' The 'Recently updated' vault sort is a separate reader (updatedAt); a score edit is a real edit there, but a no-op pull must never restamp it (invariant 36a; DI-27 broke this for the two rows).
- **Evidence:** js/core/report.js:452-456 (every journal kind); js/core/mediadb.js journalFacts/journalDiff (score is a journalled kind); user report 8 Nov in chat.
- **Root cause:** 'Activity' is not defined. Reports treat the journal as a list of things done, but it is a list of fields changed.
- **Proposed fix:** Define activity once (one derivation, invariant 26d): progress, volumes, chapter, route or hours moving FORWARD, a start or finish date in the period, or a media session that names the row. Score, notes, tags and status moves without progress (onHold, dropped, planned, a 'completed' with no progress in range) are list edits and do not make a title active. Keep them for a separate 'list changes' line if wanted. Apply it in collection() and anything else that reads the journal for activity (Home and Collection 'this week', goals). Add a smoke: a score-only week shows no title.
- **Flags:** effort S

### HR-22 · P2 · bug — A brand-new, empty account saves three weekly reports and a monthly one ('A quiet week for study', 0m) and Home announces them as '2 new'

- **Devices:** all
- **Detail / repro:** After a reset (account created today, no sessions), ensureReports backfills and saves week:2026-10-12, -19, -26 and month:2026-10, all rebuilt, with study.mins 0 and days 0. Home's Week in review card shows '2 new' with 'A quiet week for study.' over an empty chart and 'October 2026 · A quiet month for study.'; Reports lists three identical quiet weeks with flat sparklines. Invariant 102 says an empty report is not saved. The guard hasContent() treats f.plan (the shipped Pacing seed, present for every week from the first day) and f.tasks as content, and the latest week is always saved. Weeks from before the account existed (state.created) are backfilled too.
- **Evidence:** /Users/fj/Developer/KurenaiOS - Web/audit-evidence/2026-11/qa/shots/home-reports/b4-empty-reports-mac.png, /Users/fj/Developer/KurenaiOS - Web/audit-evidence/2026-11/qa/shots/home-reports/b4-empty-home-mac.png; eval after reset: week:2026-10-26/-19/-12 rebuilt=true {m:0,d:0}, month:2026-10 {m:0,d:0}; js/core/reportstore.js:228-231 (hasContent includes f.plan || f.tasks), :277-278 (latest week saved even when empty)
- **Root cause:** hasContent counts the seeded plan, which exists for every week, as content
- **Proposed fix:** Do not backfill a period that ends before state.created (or before the first ledger entry); count the plan only when a row was ticked or carried in that period; skip the latest week when it has no study, focus, collection or tick content (keep the empty-state copy for Reports instead).

If you rename the exam after studying, today's minutes drop to 0; two exams called 'Mock' share each other's minutes.
- **Evidence:** js/modules/hub.js:790-800 (examMins by label); eval of state.focus.active after Home's Start focus: objective 'Revise for Revision block 28', no examId/eventId
- **Root cause:** Identity by display text
- **Proposed fix:** Carry the event/assessment id on the session (metrics.examId) when it starts from the Focus card and count by id; keep the label match only for old entries.
- **Flags:** effort S

### HR-30 · P3 · ui — Home jumps up 43px on a redraw when you are at the bottom: the Collection desk's rows are filled after the render

- **Devices:** all
- **Detail / repro:** The Collection desk is drawn empty and filled by an async full-table mediadb.stats read (invariant 8). During KOS.rerender({background:true}) the page is briefly 1408px tall instead of 1451, so a scroll position at the bottom (679) is clamped to 636 and stays there once the rows arrive. Mid-page positions are kept. On the phone, where Continue is the last section, a background redraw (cloud pull, habit auto-tick) moves the view.
- **Evidence:** eval --size mac: scrollTop 679 -> 636 after KOS.rerender({background:true}); at 400 the position is kept (scrollHeight 1408 right after the render, 1451 after 800ms); js/modules/hub.js:1601-1606 (empty medRows/medFoot), :1645 fillCollectionCard
- **Root cause:** Async fill after a synchronous redraw with no reserved height
- **Proposed fix:** Reserve the desk's rows (min-block-size, or render the last known stats from a per-device cache and update in place) so the page height does not change during the redraw.
- **Flags:** effort S

## AG — Achievements / Badge Wall and the Governor's Seat (complete)

**Auditor's summary.** The Badge Wall and the Governor's Seat are rich and mostly correct in their core rules (earned tiers stay earned when evidence disappears, titles and showcase save through Edit seat, a theme Try on ends on leaving the shop). The serious problems are layout bugs on the user's own devices: the Seat's ⋯ menu is still cut off by the stage, and the showcase arc on iPhone draws overlapping 80px medals. Both were re-checked in this run and still happen. This run found more problems in the Governor's own pages. The Gold Shop spends up to 10,000 gold on one tap with no confirm or Undo, and it puts the item on at once. On iPhone the shop's bottom sheet stops 32px short of the right edge. The Session Log ignores the award each entry records: only Focus shows a reward, and it is recomputed. The log also has no label for Code, Japanese, Mind or Creatives entries. Recovery dispatch promises HP for ticking plan items, which pay nothing. Edit seat's preview is not inert, and choosing a title or seal drops keyboard focus to the page body. On iPhone, Titles shows its detail and Equip button 1,600px below the plaque you tapped. Root causes repeat across the area: repaint-on-change without restoring focus, a desktop layout stacked on small screens without changing how it works, copy left over from when HP gated features, and readers written before the newer session types and the recorded award field existed.

**Coverage.** Continued an interrupted earlier run (its 16 findings kept in the .jsonl, not repeated). This run looked at these, seeded and empty: Gold Shop (mac full page, iPad and iPhone measured, empty account on iPhone, item sheet on iPhone, Buy and theme Try on exercised), Avatar & profile (mac full page, touch switch sizes), Session Log (mac, iPhone, empty mac; a focus, code and quiz fixture logged through KOS.sessions.log), Edit seat (3 sizes measured; showcase toggle, title choice, Save, focus after choosing), Wall tabs Sets, Recent, Showcase and Titles at iPad and iPhone (measured; Recent and Titles shot), the unlock overlay (a 6-badge fixture on mac and iPhone, through to the summary), the Wall and Seat in the shop theme spectral-rose, a dump of all 254 badge views with values, a monotonic-earned check (vault emptied, tiers kept), and re-checks of the two P1s (⋯ menu hit test; iPhone arc geometry). Inventory matrix: findings/achievements-governor.inventory.md. NOT checked: progress pings and quiet() live with Focus running (code read only); Dawn in this run (the harness --theme flag was overridden by the saved theme, and the earlier run's dawn shots cover it); fixture tests of the Japanese, Mind, Creatives, Code, ink, Money and routines badge measures; iPad landscape of the shop and avatar pages; the cloud merge of achievements (MONO_PATH; smoke113 holds it).

### AG-01 · P1 · bug — The Seat's ⋯ menu is cut off by the stage: its Data row (Mine / Empty / Sample) is hidden and unclickable

- **Independent check:** confirmed; corroboration only, reviewed by Claude 8 Nov
- **Devices:** mac, ipad (landscape and portrait)
- **Detail / repro:** Opening ⋯ on #/governor (Status) shows a 280 x 100 popover at y=164-264; the stage starts at y=202 and paints over everything below it. Only the top of the 'HP preview' row shows; the 'Data' row (Mine / Empty / Sample) is entirely behind the hero. elementFromPoint across the popover: rows y>=204 hit .k-gv-stage (7/7 samples), rows y<=192 hit the popover. The controls cannot be reached by pointer.
- **Evidence:** shots/achievements-governor/gov_menu_crop.png (2x: HP preview row sliced by the stage edge, Data row missing), gov_menu_dpr2.png; eval occlusion rows 204-252 '7/7 outside'; css/components.css:35 (.k-pagehead[data-state~=has-art] {position:relative; isolation:isolate}), css/views/governor.css:31 (.k-gv-stage isolation:isolate), :65 (.k-gv-tools-pop z-index var(--z-menu) trapped inside the header's stacking context)
- **Root cause:** The header's isolation:isolate creates a stacking context with z-index auto, so the popover's z-index only competes inside the header; the later, isolated stage paints on top
- **Proposed fix:** Give the art page header a z-index above the page body (e.g. .k-pagehead[data-state~=has-art] { z-index: var(--z-raised) }) or, better, build the ⋯ menu with KOS.ui.menu so the popover is portalled to the top layer like the bell. Also raise the 32px ⋯ button to 44px on coarse pointers (iPad).
- **Flags:** effort S

### AG-02 · P1 · ui — iPhone Seat: showcase medals draw at 80px over each other and the XP bar, and the empty slots are 17 x 44 ovals

- **Independent check:** confirmed; corroboration only, reviewed by Claude 8 Nov
- **Devices:** iphone (402), anything under 700
- **Detail / repro:** At 402px the arc becomes a flex row of 44px slots. (1) Filled slots carry the medal with an inline --m:80px (governor-ui.js passes px:80), which beats the phone rule `.k-gv-arc-slot .k-ach-medal { --m: var(--ach-medal-sm) }`, so three picked medals render 80 x 80 at x=32/80/128, overlapping one another and rising over the XP bar. (2) The empty .k-gv-arc-note keeps flex-basis:100% while the row does not wrap (the wrap rule only applies when the note has content), so it takes 131px and the empty slots shrink to 17 x 44 (ovals); before the list() call returns, all six are ovals.
- **Evidence:** shots/achievements-governor/iphone_gov.png (six ovals), iphone_gov_ovals_crop.png (2x: 80px medals overlapping each other and the XP bar, two oval empties); eval: medals [32,580,80,80,'80px'], [80,580,80,80], [128,580,80,80]; slots [44,44]x3 + [17,44]x3; note width 131 while empty; js/modules/governor-ui.js:363-366, css/views/governor.css:518-523
- **Root cause:** Inline custom property beats the phone stylesheet; empty flex-basis:100% note squeezes the shrinkable slots
- **Proposed fix:** Set the medal size through a class/attribute (data-size) or `--m` on the slot and read it with var() fallback, or override with `.k-gv-arc-slot .k-ach-medal { --m: var(--ach-medal-sm) !important }` at <=700; give slots flex: 0 0 auto (no shrink) and hide the empty note (`.k-gv-arc-note:empty { display:none }`).
- **Flags:** effort S

### AG-03 · P2 · bug — Wall tabs and set deep links are not in the URL: #/achievements/<tab> and #/achievements/set/<id> open Sets

- **Devices:** all
- **Detail / repro:** router.js has no ENCODE/DECODE entry for the achievements view, so KOS.show("achievements","titles") leaves the hash at #/achievements and a typed/bookmarked #/achievements/recent, #/achievements/showcase, #/achievements/titles or #/achievements/set/focus decodes to no arg and draws Sets. Reloading on Titles returns to Sets; a badge link shared or opened after reload loses its set dialog. CLAUDE.md documents these routes (#/achievements[/sets|recent|showcase|titles|set/<id>]).
- **Evidence:** shots/achievements-governor/empty_achievements_recent.png, empty_achievements_titles.png (both show Sets selected); eval: KOS.show("achievements","titles") -> location.hash "#/achievements", data-page "titles"; js/core/router.js:45-104 (ENCODE) and 117-150 (DECODE) have no achievements entry
- **Root cause:** Route table in js/core/router.js omits the achievements view
- **Proposed fix:** Add achievements: ENCODE a=>typeof a==="string"&&a&&a!=="sets"?a.split("/"):null and DECODE p=>p.length?p.join("/"):null, matching the view's own split in js/modules/achievements.js:112.
- **Flags:** effort S

### AG-04 · P2 · ui — Progress ping overflows its card when the badge name is long

- **Devices:** mac, ipad, iphone
- **Detail / repro:** A ping for a long badge name (e.g. the unit badge 'Fundamentals of functional programming', 1 / 7 topics) draws the name, the count and the bar past the right edge of the 340px card: the card ends at x=568 while the text runs to ~656. The name never ellipsises although its CSS asks for it.
- **Evidence:** shots/achievements-governor/seed_governor.png and ping_long_name.png (card 228-568, '1 / 7 topics' and the bar outside it); css/views/achievements.css:275-277
- **Root cause:** .k-ach-ping-txt is display:grid with an implicit auto column sized to the nowrap row's min-content, so the flex row cannot shrink
- **Proposed fix:** Give .k-ach-ping-txt grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) (a grid's auto track takes the nowrap row's max-content width, so the b's min-inline-size:0/ellipsis never applies).
- **Flags:** effort S

### AG-05 · P2 · bug — A ping shows on top of the unlock overlay (and above any dialog) when a tier and a ping arrive in the same sweep

- **Devices:** all
- **Detail / repro:** Invariant 163 says the ping never shows while a dialog is open. In boot()'s onChange, celebrate(r.earned) only queues the overlay (drain() waits for the async A().list), then r.pings.forEach(ping) runs immediately; quiet() sees no dialog yet, so the ping appears. It sits at z-index var(--z-toast) (130) above the overlay scrim (120), at the top-left over the dimmed page while the unlock overlay is up.
- **Evidence:** shots/achievements-governor/seed_governor.png (ping at top left over the 'Regular III' unlock overlay); eval: .k-ach-pings z-index 130 vs .k-ach-unlock-overlay 120; js/modules/achievements.js:760-765, 684-689
- **Root cause:** Overlay opening is async while ping is sync; quiet() only checks dialogs already in the DOM
- **Proposed fix:** In onChange, skip pings when r.earned.length (the overlay is about to open), or have ping() also check a module-level `showing`/queue.length; drainPing should re-check quiet() before each ping.
- **Flags:** effort S

### AG-06 · P2 · ui — The current-badge ring in an opened set's strip is an oval, off-centre on its medal

- **Devices:** all
- **Detail / repro:** In a set dialog (e.g. Focus) the strip of badge chips marks the badge on show with a box-shadow ring on the button. The button measures 36 x 42.3 px, so the ring is a tall oval and the 32px medal sits in its top part, not its centre.
- **Evidence:** shots/achievements-governor/seed_set_focus.png, set_chip_oval_crop.png (2x zoom); eval: .k-ach-dlg-chip 36 x 42.3, inner .k-ach-medal 32 x 32; css/views/achievements.css:229-230
- **Root cause:** The chip button wraps an inline span medal, so its height includes line-height/descender space; border-radius:50% on a non-square box gives an ellipse
- **Proposed fix:** Make .k-ach-dlg-chip display:inline-grid; place-items:center; aspect-ratio:1; line-height:0 (the inline <span> medal inside the button adds a line box's descent). Raise it to 44px on coarse pointers (invariant 69) and draw the ring as a circle round the medal.
- **Flags:** effort S

### AG-07 · P2 · data — 'Owned' means two different things: the Wall header and the Seat say 8 badges while the set panels and the Showcase show 21

- **Devices:** all
- **Detail / repro:** KOS.achievements.counts().owned counts only badges with EVERY tier earned (8 on the seeded account), and the Wall toolbar ('Owned 8 / 254'), the Seat's glass panel ('THE WALL 8 / 254 badges') and the Governor card print it. The set panels count a badge as owned at its first tier (Time with KurenaiOS 4/6, Focus 3/6, Streaks 1/3, Study 2/11, Goals and Money 2/6, The Collection 7/11, Kurenai and the Governor 2/7 = 21), the Showcase says 'Earned 21 badges'. The same page contradicts itself; a user who earned In the zone I sees it counted in Focus 3/6 but not in Owned.
- **Evidence:** shots/achievements-governor/seed_ach.png ('Owned 8 / 254' over panels 4/6, 3/6, 1/3), seed_showcase2.png ('Earned 21 badges'); eval counts() {owned:8,tiers:44}, views with tier>0: 21, panel aria-labels sum 21; js/core/achievements.js:343-351 vs js/modules/achievements.js:220
- **Root cause:** counts().owned = fully complete badges; panel() owned = tier > 0; no shared definition
- **Proposed fix:** Pick one meaning. Either print 'Earned 21 / 254 · 8 complete' everywhere (counts() returning earned and complete), or make the panels count complete badges; and label the Seat 'Tiers earned 44 / 417' consistently beside it.
- **Flags:** effort S

### AG-08 · P2 · perf — Every Wall tab (and the Seat's showcase arc) waits 1.6-6 s on 'Reading your records…' because list() re-walks the whole vault each time

- **Devices:** all (worse on iPad/iPhone)
- **Detail / repro:** Each Wall draw (Sets, Recent, Showcase, Titles, every tab switch since each is a KOS.show) calls KOS.achievements.list(), which makes a fresh context and re-measures all 254 badges; the Collection badges open an unbounded IndexedDB cursor over every vault entry (1,880 rows on the seeded account) and tally them. Timed on the seeded account: list() 1.6-4.7 s; per set sequentially: collection 6.5 s, exams 1.8 s, study 1.4 s, mind 1.3 s. Showcase still read 'Reading your records…' after 1.5 s. It also conflicts with invariant 8 (never read an unbounded collection).
- **Evidence:** shots/achievements-governor/seed_showcase.png (blank 'Reading your records…' after 1.5 s); eval list() 4744 ms then 1623 ms; per-set timings above; js/core/achcatalogue.js:70-110 (openCursor over entries), js/core/achievements.js:329-341 (fresh makeCtx per list)
- **Root cause:** Achievements are measured on read with no memo across calls; the Collection reader is a full-table cursor
- **Proposed fix:** Cache the last evaluation's views (evaluate() already measures everything at boot and every 30 min and on owner touches) and draw the Wall from that cache immediately, refreshing in the background; for the vault, keep running tallies keyed on the vault's change notes or read counts through indexes (status/module) instead of a full cursor.
- **Flags:** effort M

### AG-09 · P2 · a11y — Edit seat's showcase picker: 21 badge buttons with no name, visible or accessible

- **Devices:** all
- **Detail / repro:** In #/governor/edit > Showcase, the 'Earned' grid draws each earned badge as a bare medal button (showcasePicker with small:true drops the name span and the medal is aria-hidden). None of the 21 buttons has an accessible name, a title or visible text: a screen reader hears 'toggle button, not pressed' 21 times, and a sighted user must recognise badges by their art (several share a palette) with no tooltip.
- **Evidence:** shots/achievements-governor/seed_edit.png; eval: 21 [data-ui~=ach.pick-item] buttons, 0 with aria-label/text/title; js/modules/achievements.js:397-401
- **Root cause:** The small variant removes the only text and the medal is decorative
- **Proposed fix:** Always set aria-label=badgeName(v) (and title) on .k-ach-pick; in the small variant add a tooltip or a name under the medal.
- **Flags:** effort S

### AG-10 · P2 · bug — Edit seat's '＋ Upload an image' uploads a new banner without the 'Your own picture' unlock

- **Devices:** all
- **Detail / repro:** Invariant 2 / roadmap 5.14: uploading a picture of your own is a gold unlock (KOS.art.canUpload). The Avatar tab honours it (bannerCropper allowUpload:false hides upload), but #/governor/edit > Background always shows '＋ Upload an image'; it calls KOS.governor.setCustomBanner(file), which opens the same cropper with the NEW file already as its source, and 'Save image' stores it. Reproduced with canUpload('banner') === false and owns('upload-all') === false: governor.bannerImg went from 19 to 52,142 chars, banner 'custom'. The cropper even says 'Uploading a new picture is an unlock in the Gold Shop' while saving the upload.
- **Evidence:** shots/achievements-governor/edit_Background.png (upload tile, no lock), upload_bypass_cropper.png (cropper with the new picture, Save image enabled); eval before/after above; js/modules/governor-ui.js:745-758, js/core/governor.js:917-935
- **Root cause:** The unlock is enforced only by hiding the cropper's own upload button; the seat editor's file input feeds the cropper a new source directly
- **Proposed fix:** In paintBg, when !KOS.art.canUpload('banner') draw the tile locked ('Your own picture · Gold Shop →', linking to the shop item) and make setCustomBanner refuse (done(new Error(...))) unless canUpload; keep picking an existing bannerImg allowed.

### AG-11 · P2 · a11y — Study cadence heatmap labels shrink to ~6px on iPhone (10px on the Mac)

On the iPhone it renders at 298px (scale 0.55), so 'May', 'Mon', 'Wed', 'Fri' are ~6px; on the Mac 509px (10.3px); the cells shrink to ~8px. Invariant 63 sets an 11px label floor for charts.

### AG-17 · P2 · ux — Gold Shop: one tap on Buy spends the gold (up to 10,000) with no confirm and no undo, and equips the item at once

- **Devices:** all; worst on touch
- **Detail / repro:** Every shop card has a Buy button that calls KOS.governor.buy directly: the gold is deducted, the item is owned and (for anything but a lab) immediately put in use by wareUse(it, true) — a new avatar, frame, seal, theme or outfit replaces what you had. There is no confirmation step, no Undo on the toast and no refund API, so a mis-tap on iPad/iPhone (Buy sits 16px from Try on on the same row) is irreversible. "Buy all" in the Try-on panel buys several at once the same way. The toast is the only feedback.
- **Evidence:** eval on #/governor/shop (mac, seeded): clicking [aria-label^="Buy Gilt ring"] → gold 12476 → 12386, no .k-dialog opened, toast "Bought Gilt ring. ◈ 12,386 left." with no action button; KOS.governor.refund/sell undefined. Code: js/modules/governor-ui.js:1046-1047 (Buy onclick → buyWare), 893-903 (buyWare → KOS.governor.buy + wareUse(it,true), toast without action), 1006-1007 (Buy all); js/core/governor.js:549-561.
- **Root cause:** buyWare treats purchase as instantly final and couples it with equip.
- **Proposed fix:** Either confirm purchases above a threshold (e.g. ≥ 500 gold) through KOS.ui.confirm with the price and balance after, or keep one-tap but give the toast an Undo that refunds and restores the previously-used item within a few seconds. Consider not auto-equipping (or say "Bought and put on" so the swap is not a surprise).
- **Flags:** effort S

### AG-18 · P2 · ui — iPhone: the Gold Shop item sheet stops 32px short of the right edge, leaving a strip of the page showing beside the bottom sheet

The sheet is 370px wide, pinned to the left edge, so the right 32px shows the shop page behind it and the sheet looks broken/off-centre.

### AG-19 · P2 · bug — Session Log shows a reward only for Focus (and re-prices it), never what quizzes, exams, cards, Code, Japanese, Mind or Creatives were paid; those four study spaces read as "Activity · Code · Code"

- **Devices:** all
- **Detail / repro:** Every session entry records what the Governor paid it (award {xp, gold}, invariant 100), but the Session Log's rewardOf() ignores it: Focus rows recompute the award through focusAward() from metrics (history is never to be re-priced, invariant 4a), Collection rows say "rest", and every other type shows no reward at all. A quiz logged in the fixture paid +18 XP +10 gold and its row shows only "Quiz completed · 80%". activityInfo() also has no case for the study spaces' own types (code, ja, mind, creatives), so their rows fall to the default: label "Activity", title = the capitalised type ("Code"), detail = the subject name ("Code") — a meaningless row. They also have category "study" by default so the Study filter works, but Japanese/Mind/Creatives get no distinguishing label. The header copy ("Open an entry for its recorded detail") promises the recorded record.
- **Evidence:** Fixture via eval: KOS.sessions.log focus (25 min pomodoro, 2 pauses) → award {xp:30,gold:4}; code → {0,0}; quiz (pct 80) → {xp:18,gold:10}. KOS.show(governor,history) rows: "18:52 | Quiz | Quiz completed | … · 80%" (no reward), "18:52 | Activity | Code | Code", "18:52 | Focus | Focus session completed | … · 25 min | +30 XP · +4 ◆". Code: js/modules/governor-ui.js:123-171 (activityInfo switch lacks code/ja/mind/creatives), 177-186 (rewardOf recomputes focus, null for everything else).
- **Root cause:** The log predates the recorded award field and the newer study spaces; it was never extended.
- **Proposed fix:** rewardOf: read s.award when present (any type; +0 shows nothing or No reward), fall back to focusAward only for pre-award entries. Add activityInfo cases for code (task/retrieval/capstone/project from metrics), ja (review session/lesson/checkpoint), mind and creatives with their own labels and details.
- **Flags:** effort M

### AG-20 · P2 · bug — Recovery dispatch promises that ticking 2 plan items restores HP, but plan ticks move no HP at all

- **Devices:** all
- **Detail / repro:** When HP is Strained or Critical the Seat shows "Route to Healthy": three tasks that "restore HP today" / "climb back fastest" — a 25-min Focus session, Tick 2 plan items, Clear an overdue task — with HP N → 30/60. Ticking plan items is Pacing's own bookkeeping with zero Governor traffic and zero sessions (invariant 82; pacing.js logs nothing), so doing that task changes HP by 0 while the checklist marks it done and advances the segments. Only Focus (+6 HP) and a reminder/assignment completion (todo, +2 HP) pay HP. Also: "Clear an overdue task" counts overdue reminders too, but its Start → only opens Assignments; and the copy says "these three" whatever HP will actually do.
- **Evidence:** js/core/governor.js:946-973 (recoveryTasks: planTicks from state.pacing.entries, go → pacing / assignments), js/core/governor.js:278 (only todo pays hp 2), js/core/pacing.js:17 ("here calls KOS.sessions.log" — never; Pacing is logistics), js/modules/governor-ui.js:540-571 (copy "these three restore HP today").
- **Root cause:** Checklist written against intent, not against the Governor's actual payers.
- **Proposed fix:** Replace the plan-ticks row with an HP-paying action (a quiz, a flashcard review, a completed reminder), or make the copy honest; route "Clear an overdue task" to whichever list holds the overdue item (Reminders Today when it is a reminder).
- **Flags:** effort S

On iPad portrait the detail starts at y=978 of a 1180 viewport, mostly below the fold.

### AG-22 · P2 · a11y — Edit seat: choosing a title or a seal rebuilds the editor and drops keyboard focus to <body>; the radio groups have no arrow keys

- **Devices:** all (keyboard, iPad with keyboard)
- **Detail / repro:** In the Title and Sigil tabs every option click runs paintEditor(), which empties and rebuilds the whole editor card (tabs included), so the button that was pressed is destroyed and focus falls to document.body — a keyboard or Switch Control user is thrown to the top of the page after every choice. Both groups are role=radiogroup with role=radio buttons but implement no Arrow-key movement or roving tabindex, so every option is its own Tab stop (17 in Title). The Title tab's "All titles on the Wall →" link also navigates away and silently discards the unsaved draft.
- **Evidence:** eval (mac, #/governor/edit, Title tab): focus an unchecked .k-gv-topt, click → document.activeElement = BODY, not inside .k-gv-editor. Code: js/modules/governor-ui.js:784-808 (opt click → paintPreview(); paintEditor(); no keydown handler), 796 (link to #/achievements/titles).
- **Root cause:** Repaint-on-change pattern without focus restoration.
- **Proposed fix:** Update aria-checked in place instead of repainting (or repaint and restore focus to the option with the same id); add roving tabindex with Arrow keys (one shared radio helper in ui.js); route the Wall link through the same unsaved-changes check as Save/Discard or open it in the set dialog.
- **Flags:** effort S

### AG-12 · P3 · ui — A four-tier badge's tiers wrap 3 + 1 in the set dialog, leaving the fourth alone on a second row

- **Proposed fix:** Use a grid: repeat(min(n,4)) at desktop when it fits, else 2 x 2 for n=4 (the phone rule at :330 already does 2 columns); key off data-n which the markup already sets.

### AG-26 · P3 · content — Unlock overlay polish: the unit is said twice ("1,000 hours · hours of games played"), the "And N more" frame is blank for 1.5 s, and its View on the Wall opens the previous badge's set

(3) summary() never reassigns viewBtn.onclick, so "View on the Wall" on the summary still opens the set of the last single badge shown (Reader) rather than the Wall or the remaining badges.

Code: js/modules/achievements.js:674-679 (tierLine), 651-666 (summary keeps viewBtn.onclick from paint()), css/views/achievements.css:252 (1500ms delay).
- **Root cause:** Overlay frames built for the single-badge case.
- **Proposed fix:** tierLine: show threshold + unit, then the description only when it does not start with the unit (or author a short tier line per badge). In summary(): set data-state skip (no delay) or a shorter delay, and point View on the Wall at #/achievements/recent.

## SC — Gold Shop and every cosmetic, themes (complete)

**Auditor's summary.** The Gold Shop sells 131 items, and many of them are broken where they are used, not just in the shop. Ten painted shelf skins and Shrine card styles never draw at all: their url() lives in a custom property and resolves to /css/views/assets/... (404). Seals are sold as 'the topbar mark', but the topbar has no mark any more. Painted frames and avatars are sized by fixed percentages that do not match the art: frames sit outside the avatar's box and spill over headings, and a gap shows inside the ring. The shop previews are drawn differently from the real component (avatar at the preview's top-left; frame cards showing the frame you are wearing). Behaviour is uneven too. 'Try anything on' covers only 5 of 15 kinds. The Exam and Sketch pen sets barely change anything and they recolour ink already written. Drawer rotation picks pictures by position in the list, not by what they show. Edit your seat's upload gets round the Profile banner unlock. On iPad portrait the Assistant never shows Kurenai, so a bought outfit is invisible there. Of the 27 paid themes, ten are near-copies of free Graphite (keep/remove list in the theme finding), and Washi Morning keeps the dark-ground red (3.2:1). Root causes: each item kind was wired by hand to its surface with no shared contract or test that a worn item renders. Swatches, descriptions and sizes are typed separately from the CSS and art they describe. The shop rebuilds the whole page after every action.

**Coverage.** Inventory matrix in audit-evidence/2026-11/qa/findings/shop-cosmetics.inventory.md. Every catalogue group (outfits, scenes, halls, finishes, banners incl. retired, avatars, CSS and painted frames, glyph and stamp seals, 29 themes, CSS and painted shelf skins and Shrine cards, papers, pen sets, 6 upload unlocks, 8 labs) was bought (seeded account, all 131 via KOS.governor.buy; empty account via card Buy) and checked where it should render; earlier batches covered frames, avatars, shelves, Shrine, Focus, share card, ink paper and theme contact sheets. This run (b4) checked: shop measured on mac/ipad/iphone (seeded and empty) plus Dawn; Assistant outfit at mac/ipadl/ipad/iphone; Avatar & profile empty at mac/iphone and seeded at 3 sizes; Edit your seat at 3 sizes; labs locked/unlocked; pen-set palettes resolved; theme token contrast for all 29; drawer rotation by season/time/condition; Buy/Use/Take off/Try on (scroll kept, focus lost); the default-theme Take off; upload-unlock gating. The earlier P1s were re-checked (avatar preview offset re-measured: img at the preview's top-left [458,3078,193] vs disc [486,3107,179]). NOT checked: two-device cloud merge of owned items and art rules; an actual file upload through the cropper (headless); every theme on every page; Decorative art off checked only by reading the code. Evidence paths in earlier findings that point to a /private/tmp scratchpad may no longer exist; copies of most are in audit-evidence/2026-11/qa/shots/shop-cosmetics/.

### SC-01 · P1 · ui — Shop avatar previews: the painted avatar escapes its disc (drawn top-left, overflowing the card) and the disc sits empty, offset

- **Independent check:** confirmed; corroboration only, reviewed by Claude 8 Nov
- **Devices:** mac, ipad, iphone
- **Detail / repro:** Every one of the 12 avatar cards in the Gold Shop (and the preview sheet) draws the picture at the preview's top-left corner, overflowing the card's top edge (the fox's ears are clipped), while the dark backing disc sits centred and empty behind/below it, so the avatar reads off-centre and the disc looks like a stray shadow. Measured at mac 1470x832: preview box 235x235 at (458,3078); disc 179x179 at (486,3107); img 193x193 at (458,3078) - the image's top-left equals the preview's, not the disc's.
- **Evidence:** /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-fj-Developer-KurenaiOS---Web/083a292e-9158-4ad4-8d86-0c9b8abd3917/scratchpad/qa/shots/shop-cosmetics/ef-1.png and /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-fj-Developer-KurenaiOS---Web/083a292e-9158-4ad4-8d86-0c9b8abd3917/scratchpad/qa/shots/shop-cosmetics/ef-2.png (Avatars rows); eval getBoundingClientRect on .k-gv-ware[data-kind=avatar]; js/modules/governor-ui.js:1227-1228 (img(it.art) uses the default class k-gv-apv-img); css/views/governor.css:589 (.k-gv-apv-img position:absolute; inset:0) vs :602-603 (.k-gv-apv-disc has no position:relative)
- **Root cause:** Generic absolute-positioned image class reused inside a non-positioned disc
- **Proposed fix:** Give the avatar img its own class (e.g. img(it.art,'k-gv-apv-disc-img')) instead of k-gv-apv-img, or make .k-gv-apv-disc position:relative and the img inset:9%; centre with object-fit:contain. Re-check the art itself: several avatar PNGs carry a baked dark disc (koi, lamp) so a second CSS disc doubles it.
- **Flags:** effort S

### SC-02 · P1 · ui — Try on panel's 'Buy · ◈ 4,500' button is illegible (dark ink on dark glass)

- **Independent check:** confirmed; corroboration only, reviewed by Claude 8 Nov

It renders with color oklch(0.2 0.03 70) (gold-ink, meant for a gold fill) on background oklch(0.14 0.01 265 / .72) (the stage's glass), i.e. near-black on near-black; the button looks disabled although it is enabled.
- **Evidence:** /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-fj-Developer-KurenaiOS---Web/083a292e-9158-4ad4-8d86-0c9b8abd3917/scratchpad/qa/shots/shop-cosmetics/seed-tryon-outfit.png (button left of 'Stop'); eval: getComputedStyle([data-ui~=shop.buy-tried]) color oklch(0.2 0.03 70), bg oklch(0.14 0.01 265/0.72); css/views/governor.css:57 '.k-gv-stage .k-btn { background: var(--gv-glass) }' (specificity 0,2,0) overrides css/views/governor.css:567 '.k-gv-buy { background: var(--gold) }' (0,1,0)

- **Independent check:** confirmed; corroboration only, reviewed by Claude 8 Nov
- **Devices:** all
- **Detail / repro:** The five new shelf skins (Paulownia, Steel and glass, Library oak, Bamboo, Sakura wood, ◈800 each) and five Shrine card styles (Moon, Moth, Camellia, Lacquer, Frost, ◈900 each), 8,500 gold in all, can be bought and worn but draw nothing. books.js and shrine.js set an inline custom property --skin-art: url(assets/app/img/<id>.webp); collection.css consumes it with background: var(--skin-art). A relative url() inside a custom property is resolved against the stylesheet that uses it, so the browser requests /css/views/assets/app/img/app.shelf.sakura.webp (404), and the same for app.shrinecard.*. Worse, the painted-skin rule also strips the default shelf's board, border and shadow (border:0; box-shadow:none), so a bought painted skin makes the Books shelf look emptier than the free default (covers floating on the page background), while the cheap CSS skins (Walnut) work.
- **Evidence:** /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-fj-Developer-KurenaiOS---Web/083a292e-9158-4ad4-8d86-0c9b8abd3917/scratchpad/qa/shots/shop-cosmetics/shelf-compare.png (top: default, middle: Walnut CSS skin, bottom: Sakura wood painted skin = nothing); /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-fj-Developer-KurenaiOS---Web/083a292e-9158-4ad4-8d86-0c9b8abd3917/scratchpad/qa/shots/shop-cosmetics/seed-books-shelf-sakura.png; /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-fj-Developer-KurenaiOS---Web/083a292e-9158-4ad4-8d86-0c9b8abd3917/scratchpad/qa/shots/shop-cosmetics/seed-shrine-gold-frost.png; eval: getComputedStyle(.k-bk-shelf).backgroundImage = url(http://127.0.0.1:9104/css/views/assets/app/img/app.shelf.sakura.webp); Shrine hero cover ::after = .../css/views/assets/app/img/app.shrinecard.frost.webp; curl 404 vs /assets/app/img/... 200; js/modules/books.js:1285; js/modules/shrine.js:954; css/views/collection.css:532-534
- **Root cause:** Relative url() inside an inline CSS custom property resolves against the consuming stylesheet's URL
- **Proposed fix:** Set the variable to an absolute URL, as dayreview.js:142 already does: 'url("' + new URL('assets/app/img/' + art + '.webp', location.href).href + '")'. Then re-check each skin's look (keep a board under the painted back panel). Add a smoke check that every --skin-art resolves.
- **Flags:** effort S
