### EX-01 · P1 · bug — Marks by question: a question added with '＋ Question' can't be given its Max or its topic

- **Independent check:** confirmed; corroboration only, reviewed by Claude 8 Nov
- **Devices:** all
- **Detail / repro:** On #/exams/attempt/<uid>/marks the ＋ Question button adds a row whose only controls are Got and Redo: Max prints '—' and Topic is an empty read-only span. Only questions filled from the past-paper index carry max/refs. For a school mock, class paper or any paper not in the index (the common case) there is no way to record the out-of, so 'full marks', 'untagged · n', the total check and the post-mortem can't work, and a Redo on such a question has no leaf to be scheduled on (invariant 124 says a redo item is due on its question's leaf). Reproduced: clicking ＋ Question gave a row with inputs ['Got, question Q5', 'Redo question Q5'] and text 'Q5 | / | — | Redo'. The Topic column is therefore empty for every hand-logged attempt (dead column).
- **Evidence:** /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-fj-Developer-KurenaiOS---Web/083a292e-9158-4ad4-8d86-0c9b8abd3917/scratchpad/qa/shots/exams-files-ink/seed-marks-addq-ipad.png, /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-fj-Developer-KurenaiOS---Web/083a292e-9158-4ad4-8d86-0c9b8abd3917/scratchpad/qa/shots/exams-files-ink/seed-marks-ipad.png; js/modules/examprac.js:410 addRow pushes {max:null, refs:[]}; :436-438 the row renders node title (read-only) and q.max as text; js/modules/tracker.js:192 questions only come from an index fill
- **Root cause:** Marks page was built around index-filled questions; addRow never got editors for max/refs
- **Proposed fix:** Make Max a small number input on rows without an index max, and the Topic cell a KOS.topicPicker button (scoped to the assessment's leaves) on every row; keep index-filled values as defaults.
- **Flags:** effort M

It is squeezed to the leftover height and its content overflows visibly, so the checklist chips ('Black pens', 'Candidate number', 'Phone off and away') sit over facts 3–5 and both are unreadable; the blacklist is pushed off below. - **Root cause:** flex item allowed to shrink below its content in a scroll container
- **Proposed fix:** Give .k-exr-body flex-shrink: 0 (or min-block-size: auto) so the room scrolls instead of overlapping; at phone width also consider putting the checklist right under the ring.

### EX-04 · P2 · bug — A transparent PNG pasted or dropped onto an ink page gets a black background

- **Devices:** all
- **Detail / repro:** readImage() in inkui.js draws every picture (paste, drop, Image… from the palette) onto a canvas and keeps it as toDataURL('image/jpeg'). JPEG has no alpha, so every transparent pixel becomes black: a diagram, a screenshot with transparency or a cut-out pasted onto a lined page shows a black box behind it on the paper.
- **Evidence:** js/core/inkui.js:1400-1413 (c.toDataURL('image/jpeg', 0.86) with no fill first); compare js/core/imagecrop.js:110-124 which keeps PNG/WebP or fills a background before JPEG
- **Root cause:** Unconditional JPEG encoding of user pictures
- **Proposed fix:** Keep image/png when the source is PNG/WebP/GIF (or when the canvas has any alpha < 255), or fill the canvas white before drawImage when JPEG is chosen.
- **Flags:** effort S

### EX-40 · P2 · data — Start-by is too strict: a one-topic test 3 days away needing 30 minutes is born 'Start-by passed · 7 days ago' and lands in Needs attention

- **Devices:** all
- **Detail / repro:** KOS.exams.startBy rounds the run-up up to whole weeks (weeks = ceil(hoursNeeded / share)) and then adds the tier's buffer, so any non-zero need costs at least 7 days + buffer. Fixture (empty account, scope = the single leaf compsci:4.10.1): topic test in 3 days → start-by 30 Oct (passed; 0.5 h needed at 2.3 h/week); retrieval quiz in 2 days → 31 Oct (passed; 0.2 h); mock in 10 days → 2 Nov (passed; 0.6 h). Only a real exam 30 days out is not already late. The red '▼ Start-by passed · N days ago' chip and the Needs attention card therefore greet almost every short-notice assessment the moment it is created (the Calendar's sample mock shows '58 days ago' on a brand-new account), which trains the learner to ignore the alarm; the plan says start-by is advisory.
- **Evidence:** /Users/fj/Developer/KurenaiOS - Web/audit-evidence/2026-11/qa/shots/exams-files-ink/b4-timetable-dawn-ipad.png; eval fixture {topic_test:{days:3,startBy:'2026-10-30',passed:true,why:'3 days of buffer + 0.5 h at about 2.3 h a week'}, retrieval_test:{days:2,passed:true}, mock:{days:10,passed:true}}; js/core/exams.js:543-544 (Math.ceil to weeks, then + buffer), :549 (passed); js/modules/exams.js:110, :458
- **Root cause:** week-granular ceiling plus fixed buffer, and no floor at the creation date
- **Proposed fix:** Compute the run-up in days (hoursNeeded / (share/7)), never put start-by before the assessment's creation date, and say 'Start now · 30 min needed' instead of 'passed' when the need still fits before the date.
- **Flags:** effort S

### EX-18 · P3 · bug — Exam Room's keep-awake is lost after the iPad is switched away and back

- **Devices:** iPad, iPhone
- **Detail / repro:** The Exam Room requests a screen wake lock once on render. The browser releases a wake lock whenever the page is hidden (app switch, Control Centre, a notification opened); nothing re-requests it on visibilitychange, so after one switch the screen dims and locks during the countdown. KOS.desk (Focus) handles this by re-syncing on visibilitychange.
- **Evidence:** js/modules/examroom.js:154 (single navigator.wakeLock.request); compare js/core/desk.js:25-36
- **Proposed fix:** Reuse KOS.desk's wake-lock helper, or listen for visibilitychange while the room is connected and re-request.
- **Flags:** effort S

## CL — Collection vaults, Shrine, Wishlist, Sync (complete)

**Auditor's summary.** The Collection is broad and mostly solid on the dense account: lazy 60-row batches work, imports do not restamp unchanged rows, and the vault shells are consistent. The main problems are structural: one row renderer or toolbar reused where the context differs (Wishlist Purchased tab, empty and filtered vault states, the iPad toolbar that overflows leftwards over the count at 1180 px and the strip that hides Games at 820 px), per-module editors each re-implementing score, cover and progress grammar (Books' own progressText, a VN percent mode the UI cannot reach, a broken cover glyph only in editors), and cross-domain links that are not maintained (deleting a vault entry leaves the Wishlist link dangling with no undo; AniList-owned lists can be renamed locally and come back). UX friction comes from a full-grid re-render on +1 that moves the card to the top under the default sort, contradictory or dead-end copy (Find new without AniList, Steam signed out, 'no import API'), and the Shrine filtered reorder that drops other media's ranks (earlier run). No P0; one P1 (Games unreachable in the iPad portrait section strip), re-verified.

**Coverage.** Runs: two earlier interrupted auditors (22 findings, kept) + this run (22 new). Sizes: mac 1470x832, ipad 820x1180, ipadl 1180x820, iphone 402x874; themes Dawn, Graphite (dusk), shop theme azure-butterfly (spot check via KOS.governor.setTheme). Empty account (reset) and dense seed (1,881 rows). DOM measurement script over #/game #/vn #/mediasync #/matrix #/shrine #/wishlist #/books at mac/ipad/iphone (scratchpad meas-*.json); screenshots under shots/collection/ (c4-* this run; b3-*, seed-*, empty-*, dawn-* earlier).
MATRIX (item -> presentation -> behaviour -> result):
- Overview #/matrix -> mac/ipad/iphone, empty+dense -> read -> earlier P2s (zero facts, empty legend card), strip P1 (re-verified this run: Games link at x484-569 inside a k-seg clipped at 496 on iPad portrait).
- Overview Analytics tab -> mac dense -> chart labels measured -> 'Bar charts clip value label', 'Genres truncated' (P3).
- Anime vault grid/rail/search/sort -> all sizes -> lazy batches verified (60 -> 540 in 60-row steps, one 53 ms long task) -> OK; +1 bump -> 'card jumps to top' (P2); Find new -> searched AniList live, Add without token -> contradictory toast (P2); editor -> no Delete for XML rows, bump on Completed (P3); filters -> filtered empty state (P2, Games).
- Seasonal -> earlier run (credit contrast, iPhone controls P3). Not re-checked.
- Books vault, lenses, editor Physical vault (Add next vol: verified writes physical.volumes[1], chip '1 vol owned'), Add range (code read: validation from<=to, >500 refused) -> mac/iphone/ipadl -> 'Owned vs read track invisible / unequal' (P3), '0 ch' grammar (P3), score placement (P3), editor tabs overflow iPhone (P3), toolbar overlap ipadl (P2), rail counts lens (earlier P2).

### CL-01 · P1 · ui — Collection section strip hides the Games vault on iPad portrait (inner pill group scrolls invisibly)

- **Independent check:** confirmed; corroboration only, reviewed by Claude 8 Nov
- **Devices:** iPad portrait 820x1180 (any 701-860 width)
- **Detail / repro:** On every Collection page at 820px the vault pill group (Overview, Anime, Books, Visual Novels, Games) is squeezed to 408px of its 484px and scrolls inside itself with its scrollbar hidden. Games is cut off at the right edge with no arrow or fade; the outer section scroller sees no overflow (sw 716 = cw 716) so its arrows never appear. A user on the iPad has no visible way to reach Games from the strip.
- **Evidence:** /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-fj-Developer-KurenaiOS---Web/083a292e-9158-4ad4-8d86-0c9b8abd3917/scratchpad/qa/shots/collection/empty-mediasync-ipad.png (strip shows Overview..Visual Novels, no Games); eval: .k-seg sw=484 cw=408 x=88, Games item x=483 w=85; shell.subnav-scroller sw=716 cw=716
- **Root cause:** css/components.css:52 `.k-seg { max-inline-size:100%; overflow-x:auto; scrollbar-width:none }` makes the group's min-content 0, so as a flex child of `.k-subnav` (components.css:80) it shrinks and scrolls itself instead of overflowing the scroller mobile-shell.js:103-125 wraps around the subnav.
- **Proposed fix:** Give the section's pill group `flex: none` inside `.k-subnav` (css/components.css:80-82) so the overflow moves to the outer `k-subnav-scroller`, which already has arrows; or drop overflow-x:auto from `.k-seg` when it is a child of `.k-subnav`.
- **Flags:** effort S

### CL-45 · P1 · bug — 'Recently updated' sorts by the row's last write, not by your list activity: provider metadata changes (AniList tag ranks, covers, totals) and sync re-inserts restamp untouched titles, while titles you actually watched or read this week sink

- **Devices:** all
- **Detail / repro:** User report 8 Nov, with screenshots of Anime and Manga. 10 of the top 15 anime under the default 'recently updated' sort had not been touched recently: Boku no Suki na Hito, Liar Game, Why Does Nobody Remember Me, Goodbye Lara, Spirit Circle, SPY x FAMILY S2/S3/Cour 2, Re:ZERO and Mushoku Tensei. Meanwhile the real recent activity on AniList (The Vermilion Mask ep 4, Summer Pockets, The Beginning After the End S2, Sasaki and Peeps; manga Hitozuma to JK ch 39-40, Hontou wa Watashi ga Iindesho?, Onna Tomodachi ch 28 and others) was not at the top. MECHANISM, from code: the sort is mediadb.js:785 `updated: b.updatedAt - a.updatedAt`. updatedAt is restamped on ANY material change of the row (sameMaterial, mediadb.js:429-441, compares every field except updatedAt, lastSyncedAt and reward), and that includes provider METADATA the pull refreshes on every cycle. One example is extra.aniTags (anilist.js topTags: AniList tags with rank >= 60, sorted by rank, top 8). Rank shifts as people vote, so the order or the set changes on popular titles. Cover/banner URLs, episode/chapter/volume totals, season, studio and duration do the same. So a popular or currently airing title rises to the top with no action from the user. AniList's own list-entry `updatedAt` (the user's last change to that entry) is not fetched (listQuery, anilist.js:226-238), so the app has no record of when the user last acted. One Piece and Mieruko-chan at the top are a one-off: the DI-27 hotfix gave them their own anime rows (inserted now). Mieruko-chan is presumably Aku no Kyouten's MAL-id twin.
- **Evidence:** User screenshots 8 Nov (Anime vault top 15; AniList activity feed; Manga vault). js/core/mediadb.js:785 (sort), :429-441 (VOLATILE / materialJSON), :1169 (restamp unless sameMaterial); js/core/anilist.js:171-210 (mapListEntry: extra.aniTags, coverUrl, totals), :226-238 (listQuery without the entry's updatedAt). Not yet confirmed live which fields changed on these rows (needs a read-only look at their stored copies, or two pulls diffed).
- **Root cause:** One timestamp does two jobs: 'this row changed, push it to the cloud' (any field) and 'you did something with this title' (list state only). Provider metadata churn moves the first, and the sort reads it as the second.
- **Proposed fix:** Add an activity stamp distinct from updatedAt. Set it from AniList's list-entry `updatedAt` (add it to listQuery, mapped as e.g. `activityAt`), from VNDB's ulist `lastmod`, and from local list-state or personal edits (progress, status, score, notes; a user save). Sort 'recently updated' by it (fall back to updatedAt only when a row has none). Keep updatedAt for cloud dirtiness. Optionally stop restamping on metadata-only changes, or normalise aniTags order, to cut cloud churn too. Use the same activity definition as HR-31, so the vault, Reports and Home agree. Smoke: a pull that only reorders tags or changes a cover leaves the sort order unchanged; a progress step moves the title to the top.
- **Flags:** effort S-M

### CL-05 · P2 · perf — Mangaka takes ~3 s to render on the dense account (reads and groups every book on each open)

- **Devices:** Mac measured; slower on iPhone
- **Detail / repro:** Navigating Home → #/mangaka with 1,107 books took ~2.9 s until the DOM settled (Books vault 1.5 s, Anime 1.1 s, Overview 0.8 s). The page queries the whole Books module, groups by author and computes works/volumes/chapters per author in the sort comparator (worksOf/mkVols/mkChapters re-filter per comparison), every paint and on every search keystroke.
- **Evidence:** eval timing: {'#/mangaka':2925ms,'#/books':1554,'#/anime':1074,'#/matrix':792,'#/shrine':882}; js/modules/books.js:1651 (full query), 1600-1603 (sort comparator recomputing worksOf per comparison)
- **Root cause:** Per-comparison recomputation in the sort (O(n log n × works)) plus an unbounded module read on every open.
- **Proposed fix:** Precompute per-author aggregates once per filter change (a map name→{works, vols, ch}) and sort on the cached values; cache the grouped rows between visits keyed on the vault's change counter.
- **Flags:** effort M

### CL-17 · P2 · data — Ordering a tied tier while the Shrine is filtered to one medium erases the hand-set rank of every other medium's titles in that tier

- **Devices:** all
- **Detail / repro:** Shrine 'Set order' builds the dialog from the FILTERED favourites. On drop it stores only the visible titles' keys as the whole tier's order, so the other media's titles in the same score lose their rank and fall to the end in 'All media'. Reproduced: tier 10 ordered under All media (7 keys stored); switched to Anime (tier shows 3 titles), moved one title -> stored list for '10' is now 3 keys; the 4 non-anime titles' positions are gone. 'Reset to date enshrined' under a filter likewise wipes the whole tier for all media, with no confirm and no undo.
- **Evidence:** eval repro on slot 17 (s1len 7 -> s2len 3); js/modules/shrine.js:809-813 (onDrop stores only list rows), 827-829 (reset, no confirm/undo), 972 (tiers from filtered favourites); js/core/media.js:580-596 setTierOrder replaces sh.order[k] whole
- **Root cause:** tier order is one flat list per score, but the dialog edits a filtered subset and writes it back as the whole list
- **Proposed fix:** On drop, merge: take the stored order for the tier, replace the visible titles' slots in place with the new sequence, keep the hidden titles where they were (or only offer Set order under All media). Make Reset confirm (or offer Undo via toast) and reset only the visible titles when filtered.
- **Flags:** effort S

- **Detail / repro:** Games › open 'Wishlist title 3' (created by Mark purchased) › Delete record › Delete: the toast says 'Deleted.' with no Undo, and the confirm does not mention that a Wishlist purchase links to it. The Wishlist's Purchased row keeps linkedEntryId 1881 and still shows the '⇄ Collection' button; pressing it only toasts 'That collection entry no longer exists.' — a dead button with no way to relink from there. All of a title's personal layer (notes, quotes, routes, physical volumes) is lost in one tap.
- **Evidence:** eval on slot 17: confirm text 'Delete “Wishlist title 3” from the collection?', toast 'Deleted.', no toast action; state.wishlist.items[id 3].linkedEntryId 1881 after deletion; Purchased tab row text '… GBP 10.00 ⇄ Collection'; click -> toast 'That collection entry no longer exists.'; js/modules/medview.js (record section Delete), js/modules/wishlist.js ('That collection entry no longer exists.')
- **Root cause:** Vault delete knows nothing about the Wishlist's linkedEntryId; Wishlist renders the link from the stored id without checking it exists.
- **Proposed fix:** Offer Undo on the delete toast (re-put the row with its syncId and drop the tombstone), mention linked Wishlist items in the confirm, and on delete clear linkedEntryId (or render the row's link as 'Link to vault' when the entry is gone).
- **Flags:** effort M

### CL-26 · P2 · ui — iPad landscape (1180): the vault toolbar overflows leftwards over the title count; search squeezed to 112px ('Search bc')

Because .k-mtoolbar is justify-content:flex-end with min-inline-size:0 and its children flex-shrink:0, the overflow spills to the LEFT and the search pill is painted over the count: '739 series' shows as '73', the search placeholder is cut to 'Search bc'.

- **Proposed fix:** Let the toolbar wrap (flex-wrap: wrap with the search taking a full row) or move the count onto its own line from the 1240 breakpoint; never use flex-end on a row that can overflow (use margin-inline-start:auto on the first item instead so overflow goes right and wraps).

### CL-28 · P3 · content — Books card prints '0 ch' for a series read by the volume; long-form progress says '1 of 1 routes' / '1 hours'

### CL-32 · P3 · data — Import and sync reports count every matched row as 'updated', even when nothing changed

- **Devices:** all
- **Detail / repro:** Re-importing the same MAL XML (or any pull) reports 'N updated' for every matched row: bulkUpsert increments `updated` on every put, including the no-op merges whose updatedAt it deliberately keeps (invariant 36a). A user re-running an import or 'Sync now' sees e.g. '0 added, 1100 updated' and cannot tell whether anything moved.
- **Evidence:** eval on slot 17: bulkUpsert of an unchanged XML row -> {added 0, updated 1}, updatedAt unchanged 1793940090274, journal 0; js/core/mediadb.js:1166-1170 (updated++ regardless of sameMaterial); js/modules/mediasync.js:55-59 (doneWording prints it)
- **Root cause:** Counter not tied to the sameMaterial branch.
- **Proposed fix:** Count `unchanged` separately when sameMaterial() holds and word the result '3 updated, 1,097 already up to date' (or skip the put entirely for an unchanged row).
- **Flags:** effort S

### CL-35 · P3 · ui — Bar charts clip the value label of the tallest bar (Score distribution '168', medium charts '222')

### CL-37 · P3 · data — Renaming or deleting a custom list that came from AniList is undone by the next pull (and a rename leaves both names)

- **Devices:** all
- **Detail / repro:** Manage custom lists offers Rename/Delete for every list, including Anime/Books lists that AniList owns. rewriteLists only rewrites local rows and the kv registry and pushes nothing (list membership is never pushed, invariant 13). On the next AniList pull, bulkUpsert treats every list name AniList passes as AniList-owned (mirrorOpts lists) and re-adds the original membership, while the renamed name is now 'only this app' and unions — so a rename yields two lists and a delete comes back. The dialog gives no hint that the list belongs to AniList.
- **Evidence:** code read: js/core/media.js:434-456 (rewriteLists, local only), js/modules/medview.js:1755-1770 (Rename/Delete for every name), js/core/mediadb.js:1089-1093 (owned AniList list names re-applied from the pull, others unioned); not reproduced end-to-end (no AniList account in the harness)
- **Root cause:** Manage lists does not know which list names the AniList mirror owns.
- **Proposed fix:** Mark lists that AniList carries (the mirror's list names, kept per module) as read-only in Manage ('Rename it on AniList'), and only offer Rename/Delete for app-only lists.
- **Flags:** effort S

### CL-42 · P3 · a11y — Dialogs opened from a vault's Actions menu return focus to the top of the page ('Skip to content') when closed

- **Detail / repro:** Games › Actions › The numbers (or Steam library…, Paste a list…) › Close: focus lands on the document's first element, 'Skip to content', instead of the Actions button, because the dialog records the menu item as its return target and the menu has been torn down by then. ## AA — Assistant, notifications, Archive (data, backups, storage, connections) (complete)

**Auditor's summary.** The Assistant, Notifications and the Archive pages render cleanly at all three device sizes and the core loops (muting kinds, the bell, scheduling, the Reset dialog, Connections' signed-out guard) work. The serious problems are in data safety and stale surfaces: Import backup replaces everything the moment a file is picked, with no confirmation, and (signed in) re-baselines the cloud; the restore merges ink instead of replacing it; the backup omits saved Reports and pot pictures (11 saved reports became 5 on a round trip into an empty slot, everything else, state included, came back exactly); and after a restore or cloud pull the rail profile and the file index stay stale because replaceState has no 'state replaced' broadcast. On the Assistant side, the earlier run's P1s stand (undo never offered, reopened chat scrolled to the top); added here: a read tool set to 'Ask first' still runs without asking, the 'Simple data requests' route is a dead control, touch targets in the chat header and the Scheduled day ovals, and Help & Guide is out of date for every space added in the last month. Root causes recur: hand-maintained lists (backup stores, Help sections, coverage text) with no test tying them to the code, and full-view rebuilds that drop focus.

**Coverage.** Earlier interrupted run (10 findings) covered Assistant chat/composer/tools/approval/activity/history/memory signed out; not repeated. This run: inventory at findings/assistant-archive.inventory.md. DOM measurement over 13 routes (7 Assistant tabs, notifications, data, storage, connections, pen, help) at mac 1470x832, ipad 820x1180 and iphone 402x874 (touch), seeded account; screenshots read for notifications (mac seeded, iphone, mac empty), scheduled (ipad, mac with a row), permissions (iphone), data (mac seeded, iphone), storage (mac, iphone, ipad empty), connections, pen, help (mac, iphone), chat header (ipad), Dawn (chat mac, data ipad). Behaviour exercised: full backup round trip (dense seed plus fixtures in money, reviews, Mind, ink, files, creatives, money pics) exported with snapshotFull and imported through the real file input into a reset (empty) slot, comparing every state key (0 differences) and every IndexedDB store count; import over existing data (money replaced, ink merged, no dialog); mute/unmute a kind; bell click; schedule add/validate/delete; Connect signed out; Pen switches; Help search; Reset dialog keys; Permissions option semantics by code trace. NOT checked: anything needing a cloud account (sign-in, History/Memory signed in, Connections OAuth, closed-app push, Sync now) — no credentials may be entered; Run now and any model reply (no AI backend in the harness); device-alert permission granted (headless denies); Export revision summary print window; ipadl landscape and iphonesafari sizes (not measured separately); a shop theme.

### AA-01 · P1 · bug — 'Undoable' Assistant actions cannot be undone: the undo each tool returns is collected and never offered

- **Independent check:** confirmed; corroboration only, reviewed by Claude 8 Nov
- **Devices:** all
- **Detail / repro:** Permissions labels every reversible tool 'Undoable action' / 'Default · runs, undoable', and the Assistant runs them without asking on that promise. Each such tool hands back an undo ({label, run}); the orchestrator pushes it into req.undos and lastUndos, but no UI ever reads KOS.ai.orchestrator.lastUndos(): the 'Verified action complete' card has only text (no Undo), no toast offers one, and Activity is read-only. Reproduced with a stubbed Ollama returning todo_add_task: the reminder 'Revise BFS and DFS' was created, the card shows 'Add task / done / Target · #1 / todo_add_task' and the thread's only button is Copy. The only way back is to find and delete the record by hand.
- **Evidence:** shots/assistant-archive/chat-tool-add-mac.png; eval: buttons in .k-asst-thread = ['Copy'], state.reminders.items[0].title 'Revise BFS and DFS'. js/core/aitools.js:1919-1920 (undo returned); js/core/aiorchestrator.js:754 (req.undos.push), :451, :1046 (lastUndos exposed); grep finds no caller of lastUndos/undos outside aiorchestrator.js; js/modules/assistant.js:2518 ('runs, undoable')
- **Root cause:** Undo plumbing finished in the orchestrator but the presentation half was never built
- **Proposed fix:** Render an Undo button on each verified-action card (and a toast with Undo, as Day Review does) wired to that call's undo.run, marking the card and the audit row 'Undone'. Keep it available until the conversation changes.
- **Flags:** effort M

### AA-02 · P1 · bug — Reopened chat starts at the oldest message, and from then on new replies and approval cards land off-screen

- **Independent check:** confirmed; corroboration only, reviewed by Claude 8 Nov
- **Devices:** Mac, iPad, iPhone
- **Detail / repro:** The thread only follows the tail when it was already within 60px of the bottom. On first render the scroller is still detached, so render() sets scrollTop on a 0-height box and, once mounted, the thread shows the TOP of the conversation. Every later render measures 'not at bottom' and keeps scrollTop 0: the user's own sent message, Kurenai's reply and the 'Confirm & run / Decline' approval card all appear below the fold while the side panel says 'Waiting for your approval'. Reproduced: leave the Assistant and return (thread scrollTop 0 of 1110, client 617), send a message → scrollTop still 0, scrollHeight 1268; the approval card for todo_delete_task was in the DOM but not visible.
- **Evidence:** shots/assistant-archive/chat-approval-mac.png (approval pending, card not visible, thread at top); eval {reopen:{st:0,sh:1110,ch:617}, after send:{st:0,sh:1268}}. js/modules/assistant.js:1615-1623 (atBottom measured before the scroller is in the document; no scroll on own send or on a pending card)
- **Root cause:** atBottom computed on a detached node; no explicit scroll on send/approval
- **Proposed fix:** Scroll to the end after the first mount (requestAnimationFrame after insertion) and always when the user sends or a confirmation card appears; keep the 'only if at bottom' rule only for streamed additions, and show a 'New message ↓' pill when not following.
- **Flags:** effort S

### AA-11 · P1 · ux — Import backup replaces everything on this device the moment a file is picked: no confirmation, no summary, no undo

- **Independent check:** confirmed; corroboration only, reviewed by Claude 8 Nov
- **Devices:** all
- **Detail / repro:** On Archive > Data, 'Import backup…' opens the file picker and the change handler calls store.importFull immediately. The only warning ('A complete restore, not a merge: the file replaces what's here') is a title tooltip, invisible on iPad/iPhone. Picking an older backup by mistake silently replaces state, media, money, reviews, Mind, creatives and files; when signed in, importFull then calls KOS.cloudsync.noteRestore(), which re-baselines the cloud (push everything, tombstone remote rows the backup lacks), so the mistake propagates to every device. Reproduced: seeded slot with an extra money transaction tZ; importing an older backup through the real file input removed tZ with no dialog (dialog:false).
- **Evidence:** audit-evidence/2026-11/qa/rt18/ink2.js result {money:['tA','tB'] (tZ gone), dialog:false}; js/modules/hub.js:3356-3378 (onchange -> importFull directly), 3376 title-only warning; js/core/store.js:623 replaceState before any check of what is lost, :727 noteRestore
- **Root cause:** Restore was wired as a direct file-input action; the danger-dialog pattern used by Reset was never applied to the equally destructive import.
- **Proposed fix:** Before restoring, parse the file and show a KOS.ui.openDialog danger confirm (Cancel focused) naming the backup's date and counts against what is on this device now, offering 'Export a backup of this device first'; say that a signed-in device will overwrite the cloud copy.
- **Flags:** effort S

### AA-03 · P2 · ui — Composer hint 'Shift + Enter for a new line' floats mid-height while the send button sits at the bottom

- **Devices:** Mac, iPad
- **Detail / repro:** The composer row is align-items:flex-end (send docks to the bottom edge) but the hint is align-self:center. With one line the three items already sit on three different centres (placeholder line ~759, hint 769, send 780 in a 60px textarea); as the textarea grows the hint drifts into the middle of the right side, detached from both the text and the send button. It is also shown on iPad (touch, often no hardware keyboard), where Shift+Enter means nothing.
- **Evidence:** shots/assistant-archive/composer-multiline-crop.png (5 lines: hint y=729, send y=760..800, textarea 675..800); chat-mac.png; chat-ipad.png shows the hint on touch. css/views/assistant.css:214 (.k-asst-composer align-items:flex-end), :220 (.k-asst-hint align-self:center); js/modules/assistant.js:913 (hint omitted only when compact)
- **Root cause:** .k-asst-hint align-self:center inside a flex-end row
- **Proposed fix:** Give the hint align-self:flex-end with a margin-block-end that puts its centre on the send button's centre (or move it under the box as a small caption, left of the send). Hide it under (pointer:coarse) / when no hover, not only in compact mode.

### AA-04 · P2 · bug — Opening a Morning/Evening review notification lands on Routines Today and never opens the review

- **Devices:** all
- **Detail / repro:** The review notice is pushed with view 'routines' and arg {review: slot}. KOS.notify.open() calls KOS.show('routines', {review:'morning'}), but KOS.views.routines only reads arg.edit or a tab string, so the arg is dropped and the page shows Routines › Today. The review sheet does not open; the user has to find the header chip. The same item reaches the bell, the Notifications page and closed-app pushes (sw notificationclick → kos-open → KOS.show), so all three dead-end.
- **Evidence:** eval: clicking the 'Morning review' row on #/notifications → location.hash '#/routines', no dialog open. js/core/dayreview.js:713 (view:'routines', arg:{review:slot}); js/core/notify.js:196-199 (open); js/modules/routines.js:469-473 (arg.review never read); grep finds no reader of arg.review anywhere.
- **Root cause:** Producer and consumer of the notification's arg disagree; no handler for {review}
- **Proposed fix:** In KOS.views.routines (or better, in notify.open for kind 'review') call KOS.reviewSheet.open(arg.review) after drawing Today, the way the header chip opens it.
- **Flags:** effort S

### AA-07 · P2 · bug — Activity (signed out) shows every action as 'Proposed … Started' forever, with no time

- **Devices:** all
- **Detail / repro:** Signed out, Activity reads the local audit queue but keeps only the 'insert' rows and drops every 'update' (executed/declined/failed), so an action that ran reads 'Proposed', 'todo_add_task · proposed' and '● Started' in one row. The queued rows have no created_at, so the 'when' column is an empty 100px gap at the row's left. The filters Ran / Declined / Failed never match anything signed out.
- **Evidence:** shots/assistant-archive/activity-after-mac.png (after a todo_add_task that the chat reported complete). js/modules/assistant.js:2587-2590 (filter r.kind === 'insert'); js/core/aiorchestrator.js:232-250 (status changes are separate 'update' rows; the insert payload has no created_at)
- **Root cause:** Queue reader ignores update rows; insert payload lacks a timestamp
- **Proposed fix:** When reading the queue, fold each 'update' patch into its insert by id and use the queue entry's ts as created_at.
- **Flags:** effort S

### AA-12 · P2 · data — Restoring a backup MERGES handwriting instead of replacing it (every other store is cleared first)

- **Devices:** all
- **Detail / repro:** A full restore is documented as a replace. Media, files, money, reviews, Mind and Creatives importAll all clear their stores first; KOS.ink.importAll only puts, so notebooks/pages that exist on the device but not in the backup survive, and the ink sync base/dead stores are left describing pages the restore may have changed. Reproduced: an extra ink doc topic:cs:4.1.2 added before import is still there afterwards while the extra money transaction was removed.
- **Evidence:** rt18/ink2.js result inkDocs ['topic:cs:4.1.1','topic:cs:4.1.2'] vs money ['tA','tB']; js/core/ink.js:531-541 (no clear) vs js/core/money.js:1097, js/core/mediadb.js:1373-1374, js/core/reviewlog.js:108, js/core/mindjournal.js:167, js/core/creatives.js:467
- **Root cause:** ink.importAll was written as an additive put, unlike the shared clear-then-put pattern of the other importAll functions.
- **Proposed fix:** Clear docs, pages, base and dead (and reset the in-memory index) in ink.importAll before putting the backup's pages, like the other stores.
- **Flags:** effort S

### AA-13 · P2 · data — Full backup leaves out saved Reports (weeks, months, words) and Money pot pictures, so a restore loses them

- **Devices:** all
- **Detail / repro:** snapshotFull serialises state, media, files, money tx, reviews, Mind, ink and creatives, but not kurenai-os-reports (saved reports and boundary snapshots, which invariant 101/102 say are saved once and never recomputed, including Kurenai-written words) nor kurenai-os-money's 'pics' store (a pot's own picture). Round trip on the seeded account: 11 saved reports before, 5 after restore into an empty slot (all September and early-October weeks gone; only those the app could re-backfill came back, now without their original snapshots/words); pics never appear in the file. Signed-out users (no kos_reports replication) lose them permanently.
- **Evidence:** Round trip: /tmp/kosqa18-before.json reports 11 -> after restore 5 (keys month:2026-09, month:2026-10, week:2026-10-12/19/26); backup keys = state, mediaEntries, mediaKV, attachments, creatives, ink, mind, money{tx,del}, reviews; js/core/store.js:513-585 (no reportStore / pics step); js/core/money.js:1079-1090 exports TX/DEL only
- **Root cause:** Each new IndexedDB was added to the backup by hand; reports and pot pictures were missed and nothing checks the backup covers every kurenai-os-* database.
- **Proposed fix:** Add KOS.reportStore.exportAll/importAll (reports + snapshots) and the money pics store to snapshotFull/importFull and the report list in the toast; update the Data page's 'What a backup covers'.
- **Flags:** effort S

### AA-14 · P2 · ui — Scheduled tab's day buttons are 32x44 ovals on iPad and iPhone

- **Devices:** iPad, iPhone
- **Detail / repro:** The seven M T W T F S S day toggles in the Scheduled form are circles on the Mac but the coarse-pointer minimum raises only their height, so on touch devices each is a 32px-wide, 44px-tall oval (invariant 69: a round control must raise its width too).

- **Root cause:** Width bound to --hit while the global coarse rule only lifts min-block-size.

### AA-15 · P2 · a11y — Toggling a notification filter (or any Notifications switch) redraws the page and drops keyboard focus to <body>

- **Devices:** all (keyboard / VoiceOver)
- **Detail / repro:** Each switch on #/notifications (Notification filters, Device alerts, Quiet hours) calls KOS.notify.setMuted/setQuiet, which emits and the whole view is rebuilt; the switch the user just pressed is replaced, so focus falls to MAIN/BODY. A keyboard or switch-control user toggling 15 filters must tab back from the top after every one. Scroll position is kept.

- **Root cause:** The notify change event triggers a full view rebuild instead of a targeted update, with no focus restoration.

### AA-16 · P2 · docs — Help & Guide is badly out of date: no entry for the Assistant, Money, Goals, Reports, Exams hub, Code, Japanese, Mind, Creatives, Achievements or Connections, and several entries describe removed features

Ticks earn XP'; Cloud Sync lives at 'Archive → Account & Cloud Sync'; Gold omits the picture-upload unlocks (roadmap 5.14); section names 'The Behavioural Governor' and 'The Collection Matrix' no longer match the rail (Governor, Collection › Overview); 'Data & housekeeping' has a '·' instead of a kanji mark. ### AA-17 · P2 · bug — After a backup restore the rail's profile card and the file index stay stale (Level 1, 0 gold; 'No files on this device yet')

- **Devices:** all
- **Detail / repro:** importFull replaces the state and the IndexedDBs in place and the Data page then calls only refreshRailCounters and KOS.show('home'). KOS.refreshHUD is never called, so the rail/phone profile card keeps the pre-restore Governor (here 'Level 1, Healthy, 0 gold' while the restored state is level 53 with 12,476 gold) until a session is logged or the app reloads; and KOS.files' in-memory index is not rebuilt, so Storage says 'No files on this device yet' / 'Every file is linked somewhere' and Files is empty although the restored notes.txt is in kurenai-os-files (KOS.files.all() = 0 until KOS.files.refresh()). Cloud pulls take the same path (cloudsync.js rerenderCurrent: refreshRailCounters + rerender, no refreshHUD), so a gold/XP change merged from another device also leaves the card stale.
- **Evidence:** shots/assistant-archive/data-seed-mac.png (rail card Level 1 / 0 gold vs 'Level 53 · ◆12,476' in What a backup covers); shots/assistant-archive/storage-seed-mac.png; eval {g:{xp:71802,gold:12476}, lvl:53, card:'Your profile — Level 1, Healthy, 0 gold'}; eval KOS.files.all().length 0 before refresh, 1 after; js/modules/hub.js:3370-3372; js/core/cloudsync.js:723-731
- **Root cause:** Each in-memory cache (HUD, files index) is refreshed only by its own events; replaceState has no broadcast that the caches subscribe to.
- **Proposed fix:** Give restore and remote-apply one 'state replaced' hook that calls refreshHUD, KOS.files.refresh, the theme apply and the rail counters (or simply reload the page after a restore, as the safest complete answer).
- **Flags:** effort S

### AA-18 · P2 · ux — Assistant Settings' 'Simple data requests' route is a dead control: nothing ever asks for the crud category, yet its 'Ollama · no model set' status shows on every Assistant page

- **Devices:** all
- **Detail / repro:** Settings › Model control offers four task routes. Every request in the app is sent as 'complex' (the composer, assistant.js:686, :1702), 'tutor' (topic actions, Help, PDF viewer, Creatives, Mind, Code review) or 'generation' (reports, reviews); no caller passes 'crud', so changing the Simple data requests provider, model or fallback has no effect. Its default (Ollama with an empty model) is what the sidebar footer prints as 'Ollama · local — no model set' on every Assistant page, which reads as a broken configuration on an iPad or iPhone where Ollama can never run.
- **Evidence:** shots/assistant-archive/settings-mac.png, memory-mac.png (footer); grep: the only uses of 'crud' are js/core/ai.js:35,44,87, js/core/aitools.js:3739 (a tool-ranking hint), js/modules/assistant.js:2136,2231; categories passed: assistant.js:686 and :1702 default 'complex'
- **Root cause:** The four-category routing was designed before the single submission path settled on 'complex'; the setting outlived its caller.
- **Proposed fix:** Either route the composer's short data requests to 'crud' (a real classifier) or remove the row and its footer status; default the route to Gemini rather than an Ollama route with no model.
- **Flags:** effort S

### AA-19 · P2 · bug — Permissions offers 'Ask first' for read-only tools, but a read tool set to Ask first still runs without asking

- **Devices:** all
- **Detail / repro:** Every non-consequential tool's select offers 'Ask first', including the read tier (e.g. Read schedule, Files list/text, Money overview). effectiveMode() returns 'ask' for it, but the executor only pauses for confirmation when the tool is consequential or (reversible AND mode ask), so a read tool the user tightened to Ask first runs silently. A user who wants to approve, say, files_list or money_transactions before Kurenai reads them gets no approval card.
- **Evidence:** eval: schedule_list tier 'read', options ['Default · runs freely','Ask first','Blocked']; js/modules/assistant.js:2517 (Ask first offered when tier !== consequential); js/core/aiorchestrator.js:147-155 (effectiveMode 'ask'), :726 (pause only for consequential or reversible+ask)
- **Root cause:** The pause condition encodes tier rules instead of reading the effective mode.
- **Proposed fix:** Pause whenever mode === 'ask' regardless of tier (keep the read tools' approval card short), or stop offering Ask first on read tools.
- **Flags:** effort S

### AA-20 · P2 · a11y — Assistant chat header's Project picker and Pin are 21px-tall chips on iPad (touch targets far under 44px)

- **Devices:** iPad, iPhone
- **Detail / repro:** On iPad (coarse pointer) the thread header's 'Project · none' select is 93x21 and '◇ Pin' is 45x21; the coarse-pointer minimum that lifts other buttons does not reach these k-asst-chip-* controls. They sit in a row with the model chip and ＋, so mis-taps are likely on the user's primary tablet.
- **Evidence:** eval at ipad: 'Conversation project' 93x21 (k-asst-chip-select), 'Pin current conversation' 45x21 (k-asst-chip-btn); shots/assistant-archive/chat-head-ipad.png, chat-dawn-mac.png; js/modules/assistant.js:1811, :2026
- **Root cause:** Chip styles are desktop-dense and outside the global touch rule's selector.
- **Proposed fix:** Give the header chips the touch block-size under (pointer: coarse) (padding or a ::before hit area that does not overlap neighbours, invariant 69).
- **Flags:** effort S

### AA-29 · P3 · ux — A fresh install's first notification is backdated: '23 plan topics carried over into this week', dated Monday 08:00, before the app existed

- **Devices:** all

## DI — Reliability and data integrity (store, merge, sync, IndexedDB, integrations logic) (complete)

**Auditor's summary.** Re-checked on HEAD 47e02c7 (sw kos-redraw-1): all 15 earlier findings still reproduce or still read the same; the code they cite changed only in two background-redraw lines. The behaviour inventory added 11 findings. The biggest data-loss risks are still the first cloud link (it replaces a device's reminders, assignments and so on without a merge) and two tabs overwriting each other. On the Todoist side, three paths create duplicates: two devices, a failed chunk, and now a second tab on the same device, because the sync lease is held per device rather than per tab. The new behaviour bugs: moving a task between linked projects in Todoist gets reverted, a reminder moved to a list linked to the other provider is copied there and orphaned in the first, 'Reset everything' leaves every IndexedDB store in place even though its dialog says it clears them, Import backup replaces everything with no confirmation, Creatives' file store is shared with the review namespaces, and the Money, review-log, Journal and Reports replicators drop their errors without a word. The common root causes: there is no single contract for what each store does on restore, reset and data-mode namespacing, the list's provider/project is not a three-way-merged field, and nothing coordinates tabs.

**Coverage.** # Data integrity — feature inventory (top-up, 7 Nov 2026, sw kos-redraw-1, HEAD 47e02c7)

Legend: P = presentation checked (sizes) · B = behaviour checked (fixture/result) · ids = finding titles (short)

### DI-27 · P0 · data-integrity — Sync rewards never stop: bulkUpsert matches by MAL id across modules, so an anime sharing a manga's MAL id flips the manga row to anime and back every autosync cycle, paying a reward each time and flooding the 2,000-entry session ledger (UR-21, live: 1,741 entries)

- **Review note (8 Nov):** HOTFIXED 8 Nov (sw kos-malfix-1, 9fecf63, smoke114): the cause is stopped. Clean-up of the 1,741 phantom ledger entries, the phantom XP/gold, the badge tiers and the two journals waits for the user's decision in the plan.
- **Devices:** all (every device that runs autosync pays and evicts on its own)
- **Detail / repro:** LIVE (8 Nov, the user's account, read-only, LA-31): 1,741 of the 2,000 ledger entries are sync-reward sessions naming Death Note and Aku no Kyouten (Books), about 40 a day since 27 Sep, each {xp 46, gold 12}: about 80,500 XP and 21,000 spendable gold of phantom pay. Real sessions are evicted by the cap (sessions.js:31 CAP=2000), so the ledger now reaches back only to about 27 Sep, which cuts streaks, a topic's minutes, goals over past ranges and Reports' longer totals. The cloud state has lost them too. MECHANISM: MAL numbers anime and manga separately, so MAL 21 is both the Death Note manga and One Piece (TV). AniList ids never collide. bulkUpsert's identity cascade (mediadb.js:1183-1213) looks up the GLOBAL 'anilist' and 'mal' indexes (:119, :126) with no module check (unlike cloudsync findByProviderId :886 and media.js dedupeVault :316). The anime pull (autosync.js:117-125) misses anilist 21, finds the manga row by mal 21, and merges One Piece (planned, 0, volumes null) into it. The reward watermark absorbs down (mediadb.js:1168). 2.5 s later the books pull misses anilist 30021 (the row now carries 21), finds the row by mal 21 again, and merges Death Note back. rewardDelta (:398-410, :1155) sees statusAdvanced (+36 units for Aku no Kyouten), and governor.js:284-295 pays 46 XP and 12 gold through logSyncRewardBatch (media.js:198). Journals gain volumes null→N every cycle (journalFacts :462-466, journalDiff :489-497); status pairs cancel within a day (:500-516). Collateral: those anime never get a row (the mirror is broken, invariant 90); kos_media is pushed twice a cycle and may upload the anime-shaped copy under the manga's syncId; gold/level badge tiers earned from the phantom pay are permanent (invariant 162); Reports' earned figures are inflated about 3,200 XP and 840 gold a week. Only rows whose MAL id equals a PLANNING anime's MAL id, where the anime had no row of its own, are hit.
- **Evidence:** docs/audit/2026-11/findings/live-account.md LA-31 (live counts); docs/audit/2026-11/harness/ur21-repro.js (jsdom + fake-indexeddb, real bulkUpsert/mirrorOpts/logSyncRewardBatch) and docs/audit/2026-11/data/ur21-repro-output.txt: each books pull pays [Death Note, statusAdvanced] in all 3 cycles; the One Piece row is never created (3 rows, not 4).
- **Root cause:** Provider identity is not scoped by module in bulkUpsert (MAL ids are per type); the reward watermark (invariant 17) assumes one row is one media item and is absorbed even by a cross-module merge. Cf. HANDOFF §6.21 (rewards without idempotent receipts).
- **Proposed fix:** (1) In tryAnilist/tryMal use index.getAll(value) and keep only rows whose module matches (no schema change; compound [module,id] indexes would need DB v9, invariant 6); merge() refuses old.module !== inc.module. (2) rewardDelta pays nothing when a merge changed module or provider identity; consider once per entry per day. (3) Regression smoke: two cycles with a colliding MAL id pay once, make 4 rows, leave the manga untouched. (4) One-time repair at boot: prune the bogus journal events; the anime insert on the next pull. (5) USER DECISION: delete the 1,741 bogus ledger entries (frees room, cannot restore evicted ones), claw back XP/gold or not (no clawback by default), and the badge tiers (invariant 162). Stopgap with no code: turn off Collection autosync until the fix ships.
- **Flags:** effort S (fix) + M (repair and decisions)

### DI-01 · P1 · data — Todoist: a reminder made on one device is duplicated when another device syncs before the state document arrives

- **Re-checked on kos-redraw-1:** holds
- **Independent check:** confirmed; corroboration only, reviewed by Claude 8 Nov
- **Devices:** all (multi-device)
- **Detail / repro:** The lease serialises Todoist network work between devices, but the LINK (reminder.ext.id) lives in the synced state document, which reaches the other device later. Device A pushes a new reminder (item_add) and links it locally; device B takes the lease next (A releases it at once) while its state still holds the reminder unlinked and its own per-device sync token predates the add. B's incremental pull returns the new Todoist task, finds no local link (byLink) and reconcile() imports it as a SECOND reminder linked to the same Todoist id; the cloud merge then keeps both (different ids/uids). Reproduced in jsdom with the smoke112 fake: after the B-side cycle, two local reminders 'Made on A' are both linked to T3 while Todoist has one task. With a Mac, iPad and iPhone all open this is the ordinary case, matching the user's 'many problems between Reminders and Todoist'.
- **Evidence:** Re-run 7 Nov: exp/td.js twodev → local 'Made on A': [[3,'T3'],[4,'T3']], remote ['T3']. Also reachable on ONE device through two tabs (see the lease finding). Original: exp/td.js twodev → local 'Made on A': [[3,'T3'],[4,'T3']], remote: ['T3']; js/core/exttasks.js:180-187 (import with no matching attempt), js/core/ext.js:306-316 (syncProvider takes the lease without pulling the cloud state first), js/core/exttasks.js:229-237
- **Root cause:** Remote link state is replicated asynchronously while the remote cursor (sync token) is per device; import has no identity check beyond byLink.
- **Proposed fix:** Make the cycle state-consistent: before taking the lease run a cloud pull (KOS.cloudsync cycle) and push the state right after the cycle; and in reconcile's import path, before adding, look for an existing reminder already linked to that remote id (dedupe byLink after any merge) or an unlinked one in the same list whose uuidOf('add|'+uid) is pending (record pending adds {uid→temp} in state.ext so any device can recognise its own item_add). Also add a boot/merge pass that folds two reminders linked to the same ext.id.
- **Flags:** effort M

### DI-02 · P1 · data — Todoist: a failed second command batch leaves the first batch's tasks unlinked, so the next sync imports them as duplicates

- **Re-checked on kos-redraw-1:** holds
- **Independent check:** confirmed; corroboration only, reviewed by Claude 8 Nov
- **Devices:** all
- **Detail / repro:** tdPush sends commands in chunks of 90 and runs every 'ok' callback (which writes the link and base) only after ALL chunks succeed. If chunk 2 fails (HTTP 429/5xx, offline, tab suspended), chunk 1's item_add commands have already created tasks in Todoist but nothing local is linked, and the sync token is not saved either. The next cycle pulls those tasks with the old token, finds no local link and imports each as a new reminder; the originals are then re-sent as item_add. Linking a list with ~45+ reminders that have a sub-task each exceeds 90 commands on the first cycle. Reproduced: 60 reminders with one sub each, chunk 2 answered 503 → cycle 2 leaves 105 local reminders (45 duplicates).
- **Evidence:** Re-run 7 Nov: exp/td.js chunk → cycle1 false 'Todoist answered 503.', remote 45 / local linked 0; cycle2 local total 105, dup 45. Original: exp/td.js chunk → 'cycle1 false Todoist answered 503 / remote items 45 local linked 0 / cycle2: local total 105 dup local 45'; js/core/exttasks.js:318-335 (ok callbacks only after the reduce over chunks resolves), js/core/exttasks.js:241-243 (token saved only after push)
- **Root cause:** Non-atomic multi-request push with all-or-nothing local bookkeeping.
- **Proposed fix:** Apply each chunk's results as soon as it returns (run the after[] entries whose commands are all in that chunk's sync_status), keep an item's parent and sub-task adds in one chunk, and persist the link/temp-id map before the next request; on the pull side, treat an incoming task whose id appears in a stored temp_id_mapping as already linked.
- **Flags:** effort M

### DI-03 · P1 · data — First cloud sign-in silently discards a device's reminders, assignments, exams, routines and other data that 'stateMeaningful' does not count

- **Re-checked on kos-redraw-1:** holds
- **Independent check:** confirmed; corroboration only, reviewed by Claude 8 Nov
- **Devices:** all
- **Detail / repro:** assessLink classifies each side with stateMeaningful(), which only looks at progress, sessions, custom cards, wishlist, tracker entries, goals, non-sample calendar events and Governor xp/gold/owned. A device whose data is reminders, assignments, Exams-hub assessments, routines, Pacing ticks, Money settings, curriculum edits, Code/Japanese/Mind/Creatives evidence or SRS state (without a logged session) counts as EMPTY, so linking it to an account that has data takes the 'remoteOnly' path: adoptRemote → applyRemoteState with no lastPushedHash → dirty = stateMeaningful(local) = false → KOS.store.replaceState(incoming). The local records are replaced without a merge, a toast or a backup. Reproduced in jsdom with smoke17's fake Supabase: a fresh device adds one reminder and one assignment, signs in to an account with history; after syncNow both are gone and the cloud copy never received them. A Home Screen install on the iPad has its own storage separate from Safari, so 'used it a bit before signing in' is a realistic path. The mirror case ('localOnly' when the remote only holds such records) overwrites the remote the same way.
- **Evidence:** Re-run 7 Nov: exp/cs.js → {before:{rem:1,asg:1}, after:{rem:[],asg:[],xp:500}, cloudHasLocal:false}. The mirror direction also exists on the push side: cloudsync.js:543-549 (conflict(): remote 'not meaningful' → upload(null) without CAS) and 744-750 (pull refuses and forceNextPush). Original: exp/cs.js → {before:{rem:1,asg:1}, after:{rem:[],asg:[]}, cloudHasLocal:false}; js/core/cloudsync.js:234-251 (stateMeaningful), 975-990 (assessLink), 758-773 (not dirty → replaceState)
- **Root cause:** A hand-maintained allowlist of 'real data' that was not extended as new domains were added; replaceState used as the adopt path.
- **Proposed fix:** Define 'meaningful' as 'differs from a freshly booted DEFAULTS document' (hash syncableState against a boot-time pristine snapshot, ignoring known seeders such as SAMPLE events and pacing seed), or enumerate every record array in cloudmerge RECORDS plus the keyed maps; and on first link always take the no-base three-way merge (union) instead of replaceState when the local side has ANY record. Snapshot the local state into the media kv before any replaceState so it can be restored.
- **Flags:** effort S

### DI-04 · P1 · data — Two open tabs or windows overwrite each other's saves (last writer wins on the whole state)

- **Re-checked on kos-redraw-1:** holds
- **Independent check:** confirmed; corroboration only, reviewed by Claude 8 Nov
- **Review note (8 Nov):** Also triggered by an app update with two tabs open: js/core/pwa.js:90-91 reloads only the tab that confirmed the update, so the other tab keeps old code and its in-memory state and can save over the confirming tab's newer edits (Gemini's GEM-006, folded in here).
- **Devices:** mac (two windows/tabs), iPad Safari with two tabs
- **Detail / repro:** Each tab keeps its own in-memory KOS.store.state and save() writes the WHOLE document to localStorage 120 ms later; nothing listens for the 'storage' event, and there is no BroadcastChannel or Web Lock. A change made in one tab is erased by the next save in the other. Reproduced on the slot with an iframe of index.html (same origin, same localStorage): tab B added 'TAB-B reminder' and saved; tab A then added its own reminder; the stored document holds A's and not B's, and tab A never learns of B's. Both tabs also mint the same nextId. With cloud sync the shared IndexedDB meta (seq, lastPushedHash, base) can let the stale tab's CAS succeed and upload a document without the other tab's record. On the MacBook a second window or a PWA window beside a tab is ordinary.
- **Evidence:** Re-checked 7 Nov: no 'storage' listener, BroadcastChannel or navigator.locks anywhere in js/ (grep); store.save still writes the whole document (store.js:395-410). Original: kos.mjs eval 17 (iframe experiment) → {afterBsaved:true, finalHasA:true, finalHasB:false, inMemA_hasB:false}; js/core/store.js:395-410 (whole-document save), no 'storage' listener anywhere in js/ (grep)
- **Root cause:** localStorage used as a single-writer store without cross-tab coordination.
- **Proposed fix:** Listen for 'storage' on the state key and, when another tab wrote, three-way merge the incoming document into memory with KOS.cloudmerge (base = last document this tab wrote/read) before the next save; or elect one writer tab with navigator.locks / BroadcastChannel and make other tabs read-only with a banner. At minimum detect a foreign write (compare a per-save nonce) and reload instead of overwriting.
- **Flags:** effort M

### DI-05 · P2 · data — Todoist: a full sync drops completed sub-tasks from the reminder (and can re-add them to Todoist as duplicates)

- **Re-checked on kos-redraw-1:** holds
- **Devices:** all
- **Detail / repro:** When the linked-project signature changes (linking or unlinking any list) the cycle requests sync_token '*' and resets the mirror. Todoist's full sync returns only active items, so completed sub-tasks are absent from the mirror; the parent's remote subs then differ from base and the pull overwrites the local subs, deleting every ticked sub-task. If the local subs were also edited, local wins, and each local sub whose x is no longer in the mirror is sent again as item_add, duplicating it in Todoist. Reproduced with a fake that, like Todoist, omits checked items from a full sync: 'Plan' (ticked) vanished locally after linking a second list. Depends on Todoist excluding completed sub-items from a full sync (documented behaviour for completed tasks).
- **Evidence:** Re-run 7 Nov: exp/td.js subs → 'after remote sub tick: [[Plan,true],[Draft,false]]' then 'after full sync: [[Draft,false]]'; remote children afterwards [[Plan,true],[Draft,false],[Proofread,false]]. Original: exp/td.js subs → 'after remote sub tick: [[Plan,true],[Draft,false]]' then 'after full sync: [[Draft,false]]'; js/core/exttasks.js:217-220 (token '*' on any link change, mirror reset), 108-113 (childrenOf reads only the mirror), 296-307 (missing x → item_add)
- **Root cause:** Absence in a full sync is interpreted as deletion.
- **Proposed fix:** Do not reset the mirror on a full sync triggered by a link change; only drop entries of projects no longer linked. Treat a sub missing from a full sync as 'unknown', not deleted (keep subs whose remote child is not returned unless is_deleted arrives), and never re-add a sub that has an x.
- **Flags:** effort S

### DI-06 · P2 · integration — Todoist: completing a repeating reminder here sends a new due string instead of closing the occurrence

- **Re-checked on kos-redraw-1:** holds
- **Devices:** all
- **Detail / repro:** KOS.reminders.complete() rolls a repeating reminder forward locally (new due, done=false) so the push sees only a 'when' change and sends item_update with due {date: next, string: 'every week', is_recurring}. Todoist never records the completion (no history/karma, completed view empty), and since Todoist parses due.string, the explicit date may be ignored and re-anchored to today, which the next pull brings back. For a Todoist-only rule (ext.rs, e.g. 'every mon, fri') the reminder instead closes locally (recur is null here) and sends item_close, so it shows as completed until the next pull un-completes it with Todoist's new date: two different behaviours for the same action.
- **Evidence:** Re-run 7 Nov: exp/td.js recur → cmds [[item_update {id:T1,due:{date:'2026-11-05',string:'every week',is_recurring:true}}]]; x-rule 'Gym' → [[item_close]]. Original: exp/td.js recur → cmds [[{type:item_update,args:{id:T1,due:{date:'2026-11-05',string:'every week',is_recurring:true}}}]]; gym: local done=true, cmds [[item_close]]; js/core/reminders.js:229-236, js/core/exttasks.js:99-107, 282-290
- **Root cause:** Local recurrence semantics duplicated instead of delegated to the provider that owns the rule.
- **Proposed fix:** For a linked repeating reminder, push item_close (Todoist rolls the date itself) and let the pull bring the new date back; treat ext.rs rules as repeating in complete() (roll forward with Todoist as the source) so both paths behave alike.
- **Flags:** effort S

### DI-07 · P2 · data — An assignment re-keyed by the cloud merge leaves its goals, Exams links, Focus sessions and review picks pointing at another assignment

- **Re-checked on kos-redraw-1:** holds
- **Devices:** multi-device
- **Detail / repro:** Ids are per-device counters; when two devices mint the same assignment id between syncs, rekeyCollisions re-keys the local one and rewrites only RECORDS[].refs. For assignments.items that list is calendar.events.assignmentId alone, but assignment ids are also stored in goals (links.assignmentId, js/core/goals.js:130), Exams assessments (links.assignmentId, js/core/exams.js:178, 536, 726), session entries and their segments (metrics.assignmentId, js/core/sessions.js:93-98; Focus banks minutes by it), and Daily Review picks (js/core/dayreview.js:489). After a re-key those references silently follow the OTHER device's assignment: minutes, goal progress and an exam's linked coursework attach to the wrong record. Reminders have the same gap (reminder ids referenced by the review picks). Calendar events have the same gap: a goal linked to an event (links.eventId) follows the other device's event after a re-key.
- **Evidence:** Re-read 7 Nov: cloudmerge.js:57-58 unchanged. Same gap for calendar events: goals store links.eventId (js/core/goals.js:131) and calendar.events' refs list only calendar.notified (cloudmerge.js:55-56). Original: js/core/cloudmerge.js:57-58 (assignments refs: calendar.events only), 293-346 (rekeyCollisions rewrites only spec.refs); references listed above
- **Root cause:** Counter ids plus a hand-maintained reference list that new features did not extend.
- **Proposed fix:** Add every reference to RECORDS[].refs (goals.items links.assignmentId as a nested field, exams.assessments links.assignmentId, sessions metrics.assignmentId and metrics.segments[].assignmentId, dayReview picks), or move assignments/reminders/events to random string ids as Money, Routines and Exams already do (the long-term fix).
