### AX-09 · P3 · ux — No haptic or tactile-equivalent feedback anywhere on iPhone/iPad

- **Re-checked on kos-redraw-1:** holds
- **Devices:** iPhone, iPad
- **Detail / repro:** Nothing in the app calls navigator.vibrate or offers any haptic substitute. On the user's touch devices the moments that would warrant one — a Focus cycle ending, the idle-watch warning, a flashcard rating, a routine completing, an unlock — rely on sound (silent on iOS, see the chime finding) or a short toast. iOS Safari does not support navigator.vibrate, so the practical substitute is a stronger, longer-lived visual cue plus a device notification for timer events while the page is hidden.
- **Evidence:** grep -rn vibrate js css sw.js → no matches | Re-check 6 Nov 2026 (kos-redraw-1): grep navigator.vibrate across js/: no hits on this build; the Badge unlock overlay and Buy add none.
- **Root cause:** No feedback-channel policy beyond toasts.
- **Proposed fix:** Add navigator.vibrate guarded calls for Android/desktop PWAs and, for iOS, make timer events post a local notification (already have the notify path) and keep the cue on screen until acknowledged.
- **Flags:** effort S

Wording is also split between 'Couldn't' and 'Could not' across 16+ toasts.

- **Root cause:** No shared error-message helper.

Programmatic focus test: Reminders' quick-add computed style is identical focused and unfocused.
- **Evidence:** css/views/productivity.css:299,303; css/views/routines.css:88-90,228; css/views/assistant.css:215,217; css/views/exams.css:503; focus test script audit-evidence/2026-11/qa/a11y-focus.js (reminders: k-rem-quick-in no indicator) | Re-check 6 Nov 2026 (kos-redraw-1): Reminders quick-add (.k-rem-quick-in) on this build: outline none and box-shadow none before and after focus (:focus-visible matched); only its parent shows a 1px hairline; the header search input likewise on every page scanned.

- **Root cause:** Two layout rules from different layers both push one element.

### AX-14 · P3 · a11y — Reduced motion is not honoured by JS smooth scrolling

- **Re-checked on kos-redraw-1:** holds
- **Devices:** all
- **Detail / repro:** base.css forces scroll-behavior:auto under prefers-reduced-motion, but that only affects CSS-driven scrolling. Twelve call sites pass behavior:'smooth' explicitly to scrollIntoView/scrollBy/scrollTo, which the browser animates regardless: every topic page turn in CS/Maths/IT, Code, Japanese, Mind and Creatives lessons (the article scrolls to its top), the shared scroller's arrow paging, the phone section strip, the Exams guide's section jump, the ink tab and the long report pages. Only the Assistant, report story, Japanese/Mind scenes and Exam Room check the media query themselves (each with its own copy of the helper).
- **Evidence:** js/core/ui.js:693; js/modules/hub.js:2874,2996; js/modules/codetopic.js:296,382; js/modules/jatopic.js:234; js/modules/mindtopic.js:292; js/modules/crtopic.js:176; js/modules/inktab.js:204; js/modules/examguide.js:109; js/modules/reportlong.js:441; js/modules/mobile-shell.js:120; css/base.css:163-169; duplicated reduced() helpers js/core/jaui.js:28, js/core/mindui.js:25, js/modules/assistant.js:250, js/modules/reportstory.js:474, js/modules/examroom.js:88 | Re-check 6 Nov 2026 (kos-redraw-1): 12 behavior:'smooth' calls (hub.js:2889, codetopic.js:296/382, reportlong.js:441, examguide.js:109, ui.js:759, mobile-shell.js:120 …) none gated on prefers-reduced-motion. (The new Badge unlock overlay does honour it: data-reduce, achievements.css:260.)
- **Root cause:** No shared motion helper; CSS reset cannot reach explicit JS behaviour.
- **Proposed fix:** Add KOS.ui.reducedMotion() and KOS.ui.scrollBehavior() ('auto' when reduced) in ui.js; replace the literal 'smooth' and the five private helpers with it.
- **Flags:** effort S

### AX-17 · P3 · a11y — Tab strips declare role=tablist/tab but ignore arrow keys and have no tabpanel

- **Re-checked on kos-redraw-1:** holds
- **Devices:** Mac, iPad with keyboard, VoiceOver
- **Detail / repro:** KOS.ui.tabs (workspace and card variants) and ~11 hand-made strips mark their buttons role='tab' with aria-selected, so VoiceOver announces 'tab, 1 of 5' and the ARIA pattern promises Left/Right arrows. Nothing implements them: on Routines' strip, ArrowRight on the selected tab leaves focus on 'Today'; every tab stays tabindex 0 (no roving focus), and no tab has aria-controls / no region has role=tabpanel. Keyboard users must Tab through every tab, and screen-reader users are told to use keys that do nothing.
- **Evidence:** js/core/ui.js:495 (role tab, aria-selected), :515 (role tablist); no Arrow handling in js/core/ui.js tabs or js/core/a11y.js; eval on #/routines: ArrowRight → focus stays 'Today', tabindexes [0,0,0,0,0], aria-controls all null; other role=tablist sites: js/engines/flashcards.js, js/modules/assistant.js, medview.js, code.js, dayreview.js, hub.js, coderider.js, codetopic.js, codecap.js, governor-ui.js, js/labs/oop.js | Re-check 6 Nov 2026 (kos-redraw-1): 31 role tab/tablist sites, 4 tabpanels; ui.js arrow handling only in the scroller (ui.js:763). The Wall's Sets/Recent/Showcase/Titles strip is the same primitive.
- **Root cause:** ARIA roles added without the keyboard behaviour they imply; hand-made strips copy the roles.
- **Proposed fix:** Either drop role=tab/tablist (these switch views, so plain buttons with aria-pressed or aria-current fit) or implement the pattern once in KOS.ui.tabs: roving tabindex, Left/Right/Home/End, aria-controls to the panel the page renders.
- **Flags:** effort S

### AX-30 · P3 · a11y — Shop actions (Try on, Use, Take off, Buy) drop keyboard focus to the page and announce nothing for Try on

- **Root cause:** Whole-panel re-render as the update path.

- **Flags:** effort S

- **Flags:** effort S

### AX-45 · P3 · ui — iPhone: Edit your seat's preview is the desktop Stage shrunk to 28% (4.5px text)

- **Devices:** iPhone
- **Detail / repro:** Edit your seat draws a live preview by rendering the 1328px-wide Stage and scaling it (transform: scale(var(--prev-s))). At 402px the scale is 0.279, so the preview's text is 4.5px tall and its showcase slots are dots; the preview is a picture of a page you cannot read, and it is not how the Seat looks on the phone (the phone Seat is a single column). The Save button is also shown as the primary action on first open with nothing changed (empty account).
- **Evidence:** shots/a11y-hci/n-edit-empty-iphone.png; eval at 402x874: .k-gv-prev-inner transform matrix(0.278614…), smallest text box 4.46px; css/views/governor.css:150-151; js/modules/governor-ui.js:655-673
- **Root cause:** The preview is a scaled desktop render regardless of the device.
- **Proposed fix:** Under 700px preview the phone composition at 1:1 (or only the parts being edited: banner, title, sigil, showcase tray), and keep Save disabled until something changes.
- **Flags:** effort M, needs a design prompt

- Use one KOS.ui.addBtn(label) helper so '+'/'＋' and the 'New/Add' verbs stay consistent

- Add an eighth Help section mark (Data & housekeeping shows '·')
- Close every open dialog on route change (one hook in the router) instead of per-surface fixes.
- Give light themes a shared paper-restatement block so new light shop themes inherit Dawn's contrast fixes.
